43Result<RTSEffectDefinition> resolveEffectDefinition(
44 definitions::DefinitionRegistry& registry, std::string_view id,
45 SubjectRef source, double durationOverride = -1.0) {
46 if (id.empty() || !source.isValid() || !std::isfinite(durationOverride))
47 return failure<RTSEffectDefinition>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
48 "RTS status effect requires an id, valid source, and finite duration override", "effect");
49 auto resolved = registry.resolve("effect", std::string(id));
50 if (!resolved) return Result<RTSEffectDefinition>::failure(resolved.status());
51 auto parsed = Value::fromJson(resolved.value().get().json);
52 if (!parsed) return Result<RTSEffectDefinition>::failure(parsed.status());
53 const auto* object = parsed.value().getIf<Value::Object>();
54 if (object == nullptr)
55 return failure<RTSEffectDefinition>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
56 "RTS status effect definition must be an object", "effect");
57 const auto number = [object](std::string_view name, double fallback) -> std::optional<double> {
58 const auto found = object->find(std::string(name));
59 if (found == object->end()) return fallback;
60 if (const auto* integer = found->second.getIf<std::int64_t>()) return static_cast<double>(*integer);
61 if (const auto* real = found->second.getIf<double>()) return *real;
62 return std::nullopt;
63 };
64 const auto duration = number("duration", 0.0);
65 const auto speed = number("speedMultiplier", 1.0);
66 const auto damage = number("damageMultiplier", 1.0);
67 const auto incoming = number("incomingDamageMultiplier", 1.0);
68 const auto healing = number("healingPerSecond", 0.0);
69 if (!duration || !speed || !damage || !incoming || !healing ||
70 !std::isfinite(*duration) || !std::isfinite(*speed) || !std::isfinite(*damage) ||
71 !std::isfinite(*incoming) || !std::isfinite(*healing) || *duration < 0.0 ||
72 *speed < 0.0 || *damage < 0.0 || *incoming < 0.0 || *healing < 0.0)
73 return failure<RTSEffectDefinition>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
74 "RTS status effect duration and modifiers must be finite non-negative numbers", "effect");
75 RTSEffectDefinition definition;
76 definition.id = std::string(id);
77 definition.source = source.format();
78 definition.duration = durationOverride >= 0.0 ? durationOverride : *duration;
79 definition.speedMultiplier = *speed;
80 definition.damageMultiplier = *damage;
81 definition.incomingDamageMultiplier = *incoming;
82 definition.healingPerSecond = *healing;
83 definition.tags = {"status:" + std::string(id)};
84 return Result<RTSEffectDefinition>::success(std::move(definition),
85 Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
86}

88Result<resource::CostSpec> scaledCost(const resource::CostSpec& source, double factor) {
89 if (!std::isfinite(factor) || factor <= 0.0)
90 return failure<resource::CostSpec>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
91 "RTS refund factor must be finite and positive", "refund.factor");
92 std::vector<resource::ResourceCost> items;
93 items.reserve(source.items().size());
94 for (const auto& item : source.items()) {
95 const auto amount = static_cast<std::int64_t>(std::llround(
96 static_cast<double>(item.amount.value()) * factor));
97 if (amount <= 0) continue;
98 auto scaled = resource::ResourceCost::create(item.resource.value(), amount);
99 if (!scaled) return Result<resource::CostSpec>::failure(scaled.status());
100 items.push_back(std::move(scaled).takeValue());
101 }
102 return resource::CostSpec::create(std::move(items));
103}

105std::uint64_t stableRallyGroup(SubjectRef subject) {
106 std::uint64_t hash = 1469598103934665603ull;
107 for (unsigned char byte : subject.format()) {
108 hash ^= byte;
109 hash *= 1099511628211ull;
110 }
111 return hash == 0 ? 1 : hash;
112}
113
114SubjectRef deterministicSubject(std::string_view seed, std::uint64_t sequence) {
115 const auto hash = [&](std::uint64_t basis) {
116 std::uint64_t value = basis;
117 for (unsigned char byte : seed) {
118 value ^= byte;
119 value *= 1099511628211ull;
120 }
121 for (unsigned shift = 0; shift < 64; shift += 8) {
122 value ^= static_cast<unsigned char>(sequence >> shift);
123 value *= 1099511628211ull;
124 }
125 return value;
126 };
127 const std::uint64_t high = hash(1469598103934665603ull);
128 const std::uint64_t low = hash(1099511628211ull);
129 PersistentId::Bytes bytes{};
130 for (unsigned index = 0; index < 8; ++index) {
131 bytes[index] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(high >> ((7 - index) * 8));
132 bytes[8 + index] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(low >> ((7 - index) * 8));
133 }
134 bytes[6] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>((bytes[6] & 0x0f) | 0x70);
135 bytes[8] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>((bytes[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80);
136 return SubjectRef::fromPersistentId(PersistentId(bytes));
137}

147Result<double> numericParameter(const Value& parameters, std::string_view name) {
148 const auto* object = parameters.getIf<Value::Object>();

150 return failure<double>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS gameplay parameters must be an object",

157 : found->second.asDouble());

178bool owns(const std::vector<ecs::EntityHandle>& handles, const T& entity) {
179 const auto live = ecs::handle_of(const_cast<T*>(&entity));
180 return std::any_of(handles.begin(), handles.end(), [&live](const auto& handle) {
181 return handle.table == live.table && handle.type == live.type && handle.id == live.id &&
182 handle.generation == live.generation;

212Result<std::vector<SubjectRef>> parseScriptSubjects(const std::vector<std::string>& texts) {
213 std::vector<SubjectRef> subjects;
214 subjects.reserve(texts.size());
215 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < texts.size(); ++index) {
216 auto subject = parseScriptSubject(texts[index], "subjects[" + std::to_string(index) + "]");
217 if (!subject) return Result<std::vector<SubjectRef>>::failure(subject.status());
218 subjects.push_back(std::move(subject).takeValue());
219 }
220 return Result<std::vector<SubjectRef>>::success(std::move(subjects));

374Result<GameplayObservation> RTS::observeGameplay(const GameplaySession& session, SubjectRef instance) const {
375 Player* player = resolvePlayer(instance);
376 if (!player)
377 return failure<GameplayObservation>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound, "RTS gameplay player was not found",
378 "instance");
379 if (!controls(session, instance))
380 return failure<GameplayObservation>(DiagnosticCode::PreconditionViolation,
381 "session does not control this RTS player", "instance");
382 Value::Array units;
383 for (const auto& handle : player->selection()->units) {
384 auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(handle));
385 if (!unit) continue;
386 auto current = unit->orders()->values.current();
387 std::string orderKind;
388 if (current) {
389 orderKind = orderKindName(current.value().kind);
390 } else if (current.code() == StatusCode::NotFound) {
391 current.ignore("idle RTS unit has no active order");
392 } else {
393 return Result<GameplayObservation>::failure(current.status());
394 }
395 units.emplace_back(Value::Object{{"activeOrder", Value(std::move(orderKind))},
396 {"arrived", Value(unit->motion()->arrived)},
397 {"subject", Value(unit->identity()->subject.format())},
398 {"x", Value(unit->motion()->x)},
399 {"y", Value(unit->motion()->y)}});
400 }
401 GameplayObservation observation;
402 observation.domain = gameplayId("gameplay:rts");
403 observation.instance = instance;
404 observation.tick = player->selection()->tick;
405 observation.revision = player->selection()->revision;
406 observation.state = Value(Value::Object{{"selectedUnits", Value(std::move(units))}});
407 return Result<GameplayObservation>::success(std::move(observation));
408}

410Result<std::vector<GameplayActionDescriptor>> RTS::availableGameplayActions(
411 const GameplaySession& session, SubjectRef instance, SubjectRef subject) const {
412 Player* player = resolvePlayer(instance);
413 Unit* unit = resolveUnit(subject);
414 if (!player || !unit)
415 return failure<std::vector<GameplayActionDescriptor>>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
416 "RTS gameplay player or unit was not found",
417 "subject");
418 if (!controls(session, instance))
419 return failure<std::vector<GameplayActionDescriptor>>(DiagnosticCode::PreconditionViolation,
420 "session does not control this RTS player",
421 "instance");
422 const auto unitHandle = ecs::handle_of(unit);
423 const bool selected = std::any_of(player->selection()->units.begin(), player->selection()->units.end(),
424 [&](const auto& handle) {
425 return handle.table == unitHandle.table && handle.type == unitHandle.type && handle.id == unitHandle.id &&
426 handle.generation == unitHandle.generation;
427 });
428 if (!selected)
429 return failure<std::vector<GameplayActionDescriptor>>(DiagnosticCode::PreconditionViolation,
430 "RTS unit is not in the player's selection",
431 "subject");
432 Value number(Value::Object{{"type", Value("number")}});
433 Value schema(Value::Object{{"x", number}, {"y", number}});
434 std::vector<GameplayActionDescriptor> actions;
435 actions.push_back({gameplayId("rts:move"), schema});
436 actions.push_back({gameplayId("rts:attack"), std::move(schema)});
437 return Result<std::vector<GameplayActionDescriptor>>::success(std::move(actions));
438}

440Result<GameplayCommandReceipt> RTS::submitGameplay(const GameplaySession& session, SubjectRef instance,
441 const GameplayCommand& command) {
442 Player* player = resolvePlayer(instance);
443 if (!player)
444 return failure<GameplayCommandReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound, "RTS gameplay player was not found",
445 "instance");
446 if (!controls(session, instance))
447 return failure<GameplayCommandReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::PreconditionViolation,
448 "session does not control this RTS player", "instance");
449 if (command.id.empty())
450 return failure<GameplayCommandReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "command id must not be empty",
451 "command.id");
452 if (command.observedTick != player->selection()->tick ||
453 command.expectedRevision != player->selection()->revision)
454 return failure<GameplayCommandReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
455 "RTS command was based on a stale observation",
456 "command.expectedRevision");
457 auto x = numericParameter(command.parameters, "x");
458 auto y = numericParameter(command.parameters, "y");
459 if (!x) return Result<GameplayCommandReceipt>::failure(x.status());
460 if (!y) return Result<GameplayCommandReceipt>::failure(y.status());
461
462 CommandSpec spec;
463 if (command.action == gameplayId("rts:move")) {
464 spec.kind = OrderKind::Move;
465 spec.definitionId = "rts:move";
466 } else if (command.action == gameplayId("rts:attack")) {
467 spec.kind = OrderKind::Attack;
468 spec.definitionId = "rts:attack";
469 } else {
470 return failure<GameplayCommandReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::Unsupported, "unsupported RTS gameplay action",
471 "command.action");
472 }
473 spec.target = {static_cast<float>(x.value()), static_cast<float>(y.value())};
474 FormationSpec formation;
475 auto accepted = fanOut(*player->selection(), spec, formation);
476 if (!accepted) return Result<GameplayCommandReceipt>::failure(accepted.status());
477 auto fanOutReceipt = std::move(accepted).takeValue();
478
479 GameplayCommandReceipt receipt;
480 receipt.commandId = command.id;
481 receipt.executionId = fanOutReceipt.orderIds.empty() ? std::string{} : fanOutReceipt.orderIds.front();
482 receipt.acceptedTick = player->selection()->tick;
483 receipt.resultingRevision = player->selection()->revision;
484 Value::Array orderIds;
485 for (auto& id : fanOutReceipt.orderIds) orderIds.emplace_back(std::move(id));
486 receipt.details = Value(Value::Object{{"accepted", Value(static_cast<std::int64_t>(fanOutReceipt.accepted))},
487 {"orderIds", Value(std::move(orderIds))}});
488 GameplayEvent event;
489 event.sequence = nextGameplayEventSequence_++;
490 event.tick = player->selection()->tick;
491 event.type = "rts.command.accepted";
492 event.subject = command.subject;
493 event.causationCommandId = command.id;
494 event.correlationId = command.id;
495 event.payload = Value(Value::Object{{"action", Value(command.action.format())},
496 {"instance", Value(instance.format())},
497 {"resultingRevision",
498 Value(static_cast<std::int64_t>(player->selection()->revision))}});
499 gameplayEvents_.push_back(std::move(event));
500 return Result<GameplayCommandReceipt>::success(std::move(receipt), Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
501}

503Result<GameplayObservation> RTS::advanceGameplay(const GameplaySession& session, SubjectRef instance,
504 const SimulationStep& simulationStep) {
505 Player* player = resolvePlayer(instance);
506 if (!player)
507 return failure<GameplayObservation>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound, "RTS gameplay player was not found",
508 "instance");
509 if (!controls(session, instance))
510 return failure<GameplayObservation>(DiagnosticCode::PreconditionViolation,
511 "session does not control this RTS player", "instance");
512 if (simulationStep.tick <= player->selection()->tick)
513 return failure<GameplayObservation>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict, "RTS simulation tick must increase",
514 "step.tick");
515 auto advanced = step(simulationStep, gameplayRuntime_->adapter);
516 if (!advanced) return Result<GameplayObservation>::failure(advanced.status());
517 std::move(advanced).takeValue();
518 player->selection()->tick = simulationStep.tick;
519 ++player->selection()->revision;
520 return observeGameplay(session, instance);
521}

523Result<std::vector<GameplayEvent>> RTS::gameplayEvents(const GameplaySession& session, SubjectRef instance,
524 std::uint64_t afterSequence) const {
525 auto observation = observeGameplay(session, instance);
526 if (!observation) return Result<std::vector<GameplayEvent>>::failure(observation.status());
527 std::move(observation).takeValue();
528 std::vector<GameplayEvent> result;
529 for (const auto& event : gameplayEvents_) {
530 const auto* eventInstance = event.payload.find("instance");
531 if (event.sequence > afterSequence && eventInstance && eventInstance->isString() &&
532 eventInstance->asString() == instance.format())
533 result.push_back(event);
534 }
535 const bool empty = result.empty();
536 return Result<std::vector<GameplayEvent>>::success(
537 std::move(result), Status::success(empty ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
538}

540Result<Unit*> RTS::newUnit(SubjectRef subject, LogicalId definition) {
541 if (!validSubject(subject))
542 return failure<Unit*>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS Unit requires a valid SubjectRef", "subject");
543 if (ownsSubject(subject))
544 return failure<Unit*>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict, "RTS SubjectRef is already owned by this module", "subject");
545 Unit* unit = Unit::createUnit(subject, std::move(definition));
546 if (unit == nullptr) return failure<Unit*>(DiagnosticCode::Failed, "ECS failed to create an RTS Unit", "unit");
547 unit->attributes()->values = AttributeComponent{};
548 if (!scriptRuntime_ || !scriptRuntime_->spawningProduction) {
549 auto attributes = RTSUnitAttributeAdapter::ensure(*unit);
550 if (!attributes) {
551 const auto status = attributes.status();
552 unit->release();
553 return Result<Unit*>::failure(status);
554 }
555 }
556 auto effects = unit->effects()->values.bindSubject(subject);
557 if (!effects) {
558 const auto status = effects.status();
559 unit->release();
560 return Result<Unit*>::failure(status);
561 }
562 units_.push_back(ecs::handle_of(unit));
563 return Result<Unit*>::success(unit, Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
564}

599 "resourceNode");

622Result<Faction*> RTS::newFaction(SubjectRef subject) {
623 if (!validSubject(subject))
624 return failure<Faction*>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS Faction requires a valid SubjectRef", "subject");
625 if (ownsSubject(subject))
626 return failure<Faction*>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict, "RTS SubjectRef is already owned by this module", "subject");
627 Faction* faction = Faction::createFaction(subject);
628 if (faction == nullptr)
629 return failure<Faction*>(DiagnosticCode::Failed, "ECS failed to create an RTS Faction", "faction");
630 factions_.push_back(ecs::handle_of(faction));
631 faction->intel()->enabled = static_cast<bool>(fogProvider_);
632 if (scriptRuntime_ && scriptRuntime_->configured) {
633 const std::string key = faction->identity()->subject.format();
634 scriptRuntime_->economies.emplace(key, std::make_unique<ScriptRuntime::EconomySlot>());
635 auto factionFov = std::make_unique<map::Fov>(scriptRuntime_->width, scriptRuntime_->height);
636 factionFov->setMode("heightmap");
637 factionFov->setEyeOffset(1.0f);
638 factionFov->setCliffBlock(0.0f);
639 for (int y = 0; y < scriptRuntime_->height; ++y)
640 for (int x = 0; x < scriptRuntime_->width; ++x)
641 if (!scriptRuntime_->terrainElevations.empty())
642 factionFov->setElevation(x, y, scriptRuntime_->terrainElevations[
643 static_cast<std::size_t>(y * scriptRuntime_->width + x)]);
644 scriptRuntime_->fovs.emplace(key, std::move(factionFov));
645 auto economyLink = EconomyLink::bind("rts/script/economy/" + key);
646 if (!economyLink) {
647 const Status status = economyLink.status();
648 scriptRuntime_->economies.erase(key);
649 scriptRuntime_->fovs.erase(key);
650 faction->release();
651 factions_.pop_back();
652 return Result<Faction*>::failure(status);
653 }
654 faction->economy()->link = std::move(economyLink).takeValue();
655 }
656 return Result<Faction*>::success(faction, Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
657}

659Result<void> RTS::materialize(Unit& unit) {
660 if (definitions_ == nullptr || !unit.definition()->id.isValid())
661 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::NoOp));
662 const std::size_t weaponCount = weapons_.size();
663 ArchetypeWeaponFactory factory = [this](std::string_view definitionId,
664 PersistentId instanceId) -> Result<weapon::WeaponEntity*> {
665 auto runtime = weapon::WeaponDefinitionRuntime::create(*definitions_, definitionId, instanceId);
666 if (!runtime) return Result<weapon::WeaponEntity*>::failure(runtime.status());
667 auto* entity = weapon::WeaponEntity::createWeapon();
668 if (entity == nullptr)
669 return failure<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(DiagnosticCode::Failed,
670 "ECS failed to create an RTS weapon instance", "weapon");
671 auto applied = runtime.value().applyTo(entity);
672 if (!applied) {
673 const Status status = applied.status();
674 entity->release();
675 return Result<weapon::WeaponEntity*>::failure(status);
676 }
677 weapons_.push_back(ecs::handle_of(entity));
678 return Result<weapon::WeaponEntity*>::success(entity, Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
679 };
680 auto applied = RTSArchetypeMaterializer::apply(*definitions_, unit, factory);
681 if (!applied) {
682 while (weapons_.size() > weaponCount) {
683 if (auto* entity = dynamic_cast<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(ecs::try_get(weapons_.back()))) entity->release();
684 weapons_.pop_back();
685 }
686 }
687 return applied;
688}
689
690Result<void> RTS::materialize(Building& building) {
691 if (definitions_ == nullptr || !building.definition()->id.isValid())
692 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::NoOp));
693 const std::size_t weaponCount = weapons_.size();
694 ArchetypeWeaponFactory factory = [this](std::string_view definitionId,
695 PersistentId instanceId) -> Result<weapon::WeaponEntity*> {
696 auto runtime = weapon::WeaponDefinitionRuntime::create(*definitions_, definitionId, instanceId);
697 if (!runtime) return Result<weapon::WeaponEntity*>::failure(runtime.status());
698 auto* entity = weapon::WeaponEntity::createWeapon();
699 if (entity == nullptr)
700 return failure<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(DiagnosticCode::Failed,
701 "ECS failed to create an RTS weapon instance", "weapon");
702 auto applied = runtime.value().applyTo(entity);
703 if (!applied) {
704 const Status status = applied.status();
705 entity->release();
706 return Result<weapon::WeaponEntity*>::failure(status);
707 }
708 weapons_.push_back(ecs::handle_of(entity));
709 return Result<weapon::WeaponEntity*>::success(entity, Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
710 };
711 auto applied = RTSArchetypeMaterializer::apply(*definitions_, building, factory);
712 if (!applied) {
713 while (weapons_.size() > weaponCount) {
714 if (auto* entity = dynamic_cast<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(ecs::try_get(weapons_.back()))) entity->release();
715 weapons_.pop_back();
716 }
717 }
718 return applied;
719}

721Result<Unit*> RTS::newFactionUnit(Faction& faction, SubjectRef subject, LogicalId definition) {
722 if (!owns(factions_, faction))
723 return failure<Unit*>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle, "RTS Faction does not belong to this facade", "faction");
724 auto created = newUnit(subject, std::move(definition));
725 if (!created) return created;
726 Unit* unit = std::move(created).takeValue();
727 const std::size_t weaponCount = weapons_.size();
728 const auto rollbackWeapons = [this, weaponCount]() {
729 while (weapons_.size() > weaponCount) {
730 if (auto* weapon = dynamic_cast<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(ecs::try_get(weapons_.back()))) weapon->release();
731 weapons_.pop_back();
732 }
733 };
734 auto archetype = materialize(*unit);
735 if (!archetype) {
736 const Status status = archetype.status();
737 unit->release();
738 units_.pop_back();
739 rollbackWeapons();
740 return Result<Unit*>::failure(status);
741 }
742 auto link = FactionLink::bind(ecs::handle_of(&faction));
743 if (!link) {
744 const Status status = link.status();
745 unit->release();
746 units_.pop_back();
747 rollbackWeapons();
748 return Result<Unit*>::failure(status);
749 }
750 unit->faction()->link = std::move(link).takeValue();
751 faction.members()->units.push_back(ecs::handle_of(unit));
752 if (scriptRuntime_ && scriptRuntime_->configured) {
753 const std::string key = unit->identity()->subject.format();
754 auto crowdLink = CrowdLink::bind(key);
755 auto sensingLink = SensingLink::bind(key);
756 if (!crowdLink || !sensingLink) {
757 const Status status = !crowdLink ? crowdLink.status() : sensingLink.status();
758 faction.members()->units.pop_back();
759 unit->release();
760 units_.pop_back();
761 rollbackWeapons();
762 return Result<Unit*>::failure(status);
763 }
764 unit->crowd()->link = std::move(crowdLink).takeValue();
765 unit->sensing()->link = std::move(sensingLink).takeValue();
766 }
767 return Result<Unit*>::success(unit, Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
768}

770Result<Building*> RTS::newFactionBuilding(Faction& faction, SubjectRef subject, LogicalId definition) {
771 if (!owns(factions_, faction))

773 "faction");
774 auto created = newBuilding(subject, std::move(definition));
775 if (!created) return created;

779 while (weapons_.size() > weaponCount) {
780 if (auto* weapon = dynamic_cast<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(ecs::try_get(weapons_.back()))) weapon->release();
781 weapons_.pop_back();
782 }
783 };
784 auto archetype = materialize(*building);
785 if (!archetype) {
786 const Status status = archetype.status();
787 building->release();
788 buildings_.pop_back();
789 rollbackWeapons();
790 return Result<Building*>::failure(status);

799 }

801 faction.members()->buildings.push_back(ecs::handle_of(building));
802 return Result<Building*>::success(building, Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));

816Result<void> RTS::configureMatch(Match& match, VictoryRule rule, std::string archetype,
817 double targetValue) const {
818 if (!owns(matches_, match))
819 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
820 "RTS match is not owned by this composition root", "match");
821 if (match.state()->phase != MatchPhase::Setup)
822 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict, "RTS match rules are immutable after start", "match.phase");
823 if (rule == VictoryRule::DestroyHeadquarters && archetype.empty())
824 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
825 "RTS headquarters victory requires an archetype", "archetype");
826 if (rule == VictoryRule::ResourceTarget &&
827 (archetype.empty() || !std::isfinite(targetValue) || targetValue <= 0.0))
828 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
829 "RTS resource victory requires a resource and positive target", "targetValue");
830 match.rules()->rule = rule;
831 match.rules()->archetype = std::move(archetype);
832 match.rules()->targetValue = targetValue;
833 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
834}

857Result<Value> RTS::inspectMatch(Match& match) const {
858 if (!owns(matches_, match))
859 return failure<Value>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
860 "RTS match is not owned by this composition root", "match");
861 const auto phase = match.state()->phase == MatchPhase::Setup ? "setup" :
862 match.state()->phase == MatchPhase::Running ? "running" : "finished";
863 Value::Array participants;
864 for (auto& entry : match.participants()->entries) {
865 auto* faction = dynamic_cast<Faction*>(entry.faction.resolve());
866 participants.emplace_back(Value::Object{
867 {"faction", faction == nullptr ? std::string{} : faction->identity()->subject.format()},
868 {"team", entry.team}, {"eliminated", entry.eliminated},
869 {"surrendered", entry.surrendered}, {"reason", entry.reason}});
870 }
871 Value::Array events;
872 for (const auto& event : match.events()->values)
873 events.emplace_back(Value::Object{{"sequence", static_cast<std::int64_t>(event.sequence)},
874 {"kind", event.kind}, {"faction", event.faction.isValid() ? event.faction.format() : std::string{}},
875 {"team", event.team}, {"reason", event.reason}});
876 return Result<Value>::success(Value(Value::Object{
877 {"subject", match.identity()->subject.format()}, {"phase", phase},
878 {"winningTeam", match.state()->winningTeam},
879 {"rule", static_cast<std::int64_t>(match.rules()->rule)},
880 {"archetype", match.rules()->archetype}, {"target", match.rules()->targetValue},
881 {"participants", Value(std::move(participants))}, {"events", Value(std::move(events))}}),
882 Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
883}

908Result<FanOutReceipt> RTS::commandUnits(std::span<const SubjectRef> subjects, const CommandSpec& command,

924Result<void> RTS::setUnitStance(std::span<const SubjectRef> subjects, CombatStance stance,
925 float leashRange) const {
926 if (stance != CombatStance::Passive && stance != CombatStance::Defensive &&
927 stance != CombatStance::Aggressive)
928 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS combat stance is invalid", "stance");
929 if (!std::isfinite(leashRange) || leashRange < 0.0f)
930 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
931 "RTS combat leash range must be finite and non-negative", "leashRange");
932 std::vector<Unit*> units;
933 units.reserve(subjects.size());
934 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < subjects.size(); ++index) {
935 auto* unit = findUnit(subjects[index]);
936 if (unit == nullptr)
937 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound, "RTS stance unit identity was not found",
938 "subjects[" + std::to_string(index) + "]");
939 units.push_back(unit);
940 }
941 for (auto* unit : units) {
942 auto combat = unit->combat();
943 combat->stance = stance;
944 combat->leashRange = leashRange;
945 combat->guardX = unit->motion()->x;
946 combat->guardY = unit->motion()->y;
947 combat->guardSet = true;
948 if (stance == CombatStance::Passive && unit->orders()->values.orderCount() == 0)
949 combat->target = {};
950 }
951 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
952}

954Result<void> RTS::setUnitMovementPriority(std::span<const SubjectRef> subjects, int priority) const {
955 std::vector<Unit*> units;
956 units.reserve(subjects.size());
957 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < subjects.size(); ++index) {
958 auto* unit = findUnit(subjects[index]);
959 if (unit == nullptr)
960 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound, "RTS movement-priority unit identity was not found",
961 "subjects[" + std::to_string(index) + "]");
962 units.push_back(unit);
963 }
964 const int clamped = std::clamp(priority, -100, 100);
965 for (auto* unit : units) unit->navigation()->movementPriority = clamped;
966 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
967}

969Result<void> RTS::assignWorker(Unit& worker, ResourceNode& node, Building& dropoff) const {
970 if (!owns(units_, worker) || !owns(resourceNodes_, node) || !owns(buildings_, dropoff))
971 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
972 "RTS worker assignment requires roots owned by this facade", "assignment");
973 if (!worker.durability()->alive || worker.durability()->state.health <= 0.0)
974 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict, "RTS worker must be alive", "worker");
975 if (worker.worker()->capacity <= 0.0f || worker.worker()->gatherRate <= 0.0f ||
976 worker.worker()->resourceType.empty())
977 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
978 "RTS unit is not configured as a resource worker", "worker");
979 if ((!node.stock()->infinite && node.stock()->remaining <= 0.0f) ||
980 node.stock()->resourceType != worker.worker()->resourceType)
981 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
982 "RTS resource node is depleted or incompatible with the worker", "node");
983 if (!dropoff.integrity()->alive || dropoff.construction()->progress < 1.0f ||
984 worker.faction()->link.resolve() == nullptr ||
985 worker.faction()->link.resolve() != dropoff.faction()->link.resolve() ||
986 std::find(dropoff.dropoff()->acceptedResources.begin(), dropoff.dropoff()->acceptedResources.end(),
987 worker.worker()->resourceType) == dropoff.dropoff()->acceptedResources.end())
988 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
989 "RTS dropoff must be completed, friendly, and accept the resource", "dropoff");
990
991 auto& assigned = node.harvest()->workers;
992 std::erase_if(assigned, [](const ecs::EntityHandle& handle) { return ecs::try_get(handle) == nullptr; });
993 const auto workerHandle = ecs::handle_of(&worker);
994 const bool alreadyAssigned = std::any_of(assigned.begin(), assigned.end(), [&](const auto& handle) {
995 return sameHandle(handle, workerHandle);
996 });
997 if (!alreadyAssigned && assigned.size() >= node.harvest()->capacity)
998 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict, "RTS resource node worker capacity is full", "node");
999
1000 auto nodeLink = ResourceNodeLink::bind(ecs::handle_of(&node));
1001 if (!nodeLink) return Result<void>::failure(nodeLink.status());
1002 auto dropoffLink = BuildingLink::bind(ecs::handle_of(&dropoff));
1003 if (!dropoffLink) return Result<void>::failure(dropoffLink.status());
1004 CommandSpec command;
1005 command.kind = OrderKind::Gather;
1006 command.target = {node.position()->x, node.position()->y};
1007 command.targetEntity = ecs::handle_of(&node);
1008 auto ordered = worker.orders()->values.replace(command);
1009 if (!ordered) return Result<void>::failure(ordered.status());
1010 std::move(ordered).takeValue();
1011
1012 if (auto* previous = dynamic_cast<ResourceNode*>(worker.worker()->resourceNode.resolve());
1013 previous != nullptr && previous != &node) {
1014 std::erase_if(previous->harvest()->workers, [&](const auto& handle) {
1015 return sameHandle(handle, workerHandle);
1016 });
1017 }
1018 if (!alreadyAssigned) assigned.push_back(workerHandle);
1019 worker.worker()->resourceNode = std::move(nodeLink).takeValue();
1020 worker.worker()->dropoff = std::move(dropoffLink).takeValue();
1021 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
1022}
1023
1024Result<void> RTS::setWorkerAutoAssignment(std::span<const SubjectRef> subjects, bool enabled) const {
1025 std::vector<Unit*> workers;
1026 workers.reserve(subjects.size());
1027 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < subjects.size(); ++index) {
1028 auto* unit = findUnit(subjects[index]);
1029 if (unit == nullptr)
1030 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
1031 "RTS auto-assignment unit identity was not found",
1032 "subjects[" + std::to_string(index) + "]");
1033 if (unit->worker()->capacity <= 0.0f || unit->worker()->gatherRate <= 0.0f ||
1034 unit->worker()->resourceType.empty())
1035 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
1036 "RTS auto-assignment target is not a resource worker",
1037 "subjects[" + std::to_string(index) + "]");
1038 workers.push_back(unit);
1039 }
1040 for (auto* worker : workers) worker->worker()->autoAssign = enabled;
1041 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
1042}

1044Result<void> RTS::configureWorkforce(Faction& faction, bool autoConstruction,
1045 int maxBuildersPerSite, bool autoRepair,
1046 int maxRepairersPerBuilding, int reserveWorkers) const {
1047 if (!owns(factions_, faction))
1048 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
1049 "RTS workforce faction does not belong to this facade", "faction");
1050 if (maxBuildersPerSite <= 0 || maxRepairersPerBuilding <= 0 || reserveWorkers < 0)
1051 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
1052 "RTS workforce limits must be positive and reserve workers non-negative",
1053 "workforce");
1054 auto workforce = faction.workforce();
1055 workforce->autoConstruction = autoConstruction;
1056 workforce->autoRepair = autoRepair;
1057 workforce->maxBuildersPerSite = static_cast<std::size_t>(maxBuildersPerSite);
1058 workforce->maxRepairersPerBuilding = static_cast<std::size_t>(maxRepairersPerBuilding);
1059 workforce->reserveWorkers = static_cast<std::size_t>(reserveWorkers);
1060 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
1061}

1063Result<std::string> RTS::assignBuilder(Unit& worker, Building& building) const {
1064 if (!owns(units_, worker) || !owns(buildings_, building))
1065 return failure<std::string>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
1066 "RTS builder assignment requires roots owned by this facade", "assignment");
1067 if (!worker.durability()->alive || worker.containment()->container.isBound() ||
1068 worker.worker()->buildRate <= 0.0f)
1069 return failure<std::string>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
1070 "RTS builder must be alive, deployed, and construction-capable", "worker");
1071 if (!building.integrity()->alive || building.construction()->progress >= 1.0f ||
1072 building.construction()->paused)
1073 return failure<std::string>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
1074 "RTS construction target must be alive, unfinished, and active", "building");
1075 if (worker.faction()->link.resolve() == nullptr ||
1076 worker.faction()->link.resolve() != building.faction()->link.resolve())
1077 return failure<std::string>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
1078 "RTS builder and construction target must share a faction", "assignment");
1079 CommandSpec command;
1080 command.kind = OrderKind::Build;
1081 command.target = {building.placement()->worldX, building.placement()->worldY};
1082 command.targetEntity = building.identity()->self;
1083 auto ordered = worker.orders()->values.replace(command);
1084 if (!ordered) return Result<std::string>::failure(ordered.status());
1085 return ordered;
1086}
1087
1088Result<int> RTS::addUnitReserveAmmo(Unit& unit, int rounds) const {
1089 if (!owns(units_, unit))
1090 return failure<int>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
1091 "RTS reserve-ammunition unit does not belong to this facade", "unit");
1092 if (!unit.durability()->alive)
1093 return failure<int>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict, "RTS reserve-ammunition unit must be alive", "unit");
1094 auto* weaponEntity = dynamic_cast<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(unit.weapon()->link.resolve());
1095 if (weaponEntity == nullptr)
1096 return failure<int>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound, "RTS unit has no canonical weapon", "unit.weapon");
1097 auto& resource = weaponEntity->state()->resource;
1098 if (resource.kind != weapon::ResourceKind::Ammo || resource.infinite)
1099 return failure<int>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
1100 "RTS unit weapon has no finite reserve ammunition", "unit.weapon.resource");
1101 if (auto* pool = weaponEntity->state()->ammoPool) {
1102 if (pool->state()->max < 0)
1103 return failure<int>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
1104 "RTS unit weapon ammunition pool is infinite", "unit.weapon.ammoPool");
1105 const long long adjusted = static_cast<long long>(pool->state()->count) + rounds;
1106 pool->state()->count = static_cast<int>(std::clamp<long long>(adjusted, 0, pool->state()->max));
1107 return Result<int>::success(pool->state()->count, Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
1108 }
1109 if (resource.reserve < 0)
1110 return failure<int>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
1111 "RTS unit weapon reserve ammunition is infinite", "unit.weapon.resource.reserve");
1112 const auto* definition = weaponEntity->definition()->def;
1113 const int capacity = std::max(resource.reserve, definition == nullptr ? resource.reserve : definition->reserveSize);
1114 const long long adjusted = static_cast<long long>(resource.reserve) + rounds;
1115 resource.reserve = static_cast<int>(std::clamp<long long>(adjusted, 0, capacity));
1116 return Result<int>::success(resource.reserve, Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
1117}
1118
1119Result<float> RTS::addUnitAmmoSupply(Unit& unit, float rounds) const {
1120 if (!owns(units_, unit))
1121 return failure<float>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
1122 "RTS ammunition-supply unit does not belong to this facade", "unit");
1123 if (!unit.durability()->alive)
1124 return failure<float>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict, "RTS ammunition-supply unit must be alive", "unit");
1125 if (!std::isfinite(rounds))
1126 return failure<float>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
1127 "RTS ammunition supply adjustment must be finite", "rounds");
1128 auto supply = unit.supply();
1129 supply->stock = std::clamp(supply->stock + rounds, 0.0f, std::max(0.0f, supply->capacity));
1130 return Result<float>::success(supply->stock, Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
1131}

1133Result<float> RTS::addBuildingAmmoSupply(Building& building, float rounds) const {
1134 if (!owns(buildings_, building))
1135 return failure<float>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,

1139 if (!std::isfinite(rounds))
1140 return failure<float>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
1141 "RTS ammunition supply adjustment must be finite", "rounds");
1142 auto supply = building.supply();
1143 supply->stock = std::clamp(supply->stock + rounds, 0.0f, std::max(0.0f, supply->capacity));

1147Result<void> RTS::setUnitAutoResupply(Unit& unit, bool enabled) const {
1148 if (!owns(units_, unit))
1149 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
1150 "RTS automatic-resupply unit does not belong to this facade", "unit");
1151 if (!unit.durability()->alive)
1152 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict, "RTS automatic-resupply unit must be alive", "unit");
1153 auto supply = unit.supply();
1154 supply->autoDispatch = enabled;
1155 if (enabled) return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
1156 auto current = unit.orders()->values.current();
1157 if (current && (current.value().kind == OrderKind::Resupply || current.value().kind == OrderKind::SupplyRelay)) {
1158 auto cancelled = unit.orders()->values.cancel(current.value().id, "automatic resupply disabled");
1159 if (!cancelled) return cancelled;
1160 supply->assignedTarget = {};
1161 supply->reservedStock = 0.0f;
1162 supply->returning = false;
1163 supply->rendezvousActive = false;
1164 supply->convoyWaiting = false;
1165 supply->convoyLeader = {};
1166 auto navigation = unit.navigation();
1167 navigation->waypoints.clear();
1168 navigation->waypointIndex = 0;
1169 navigation->plannedOrderId.clear();
1170 navigation->unreachable = false;
1171 navigation->unreachableReported = false;
1172 unit.motion()->arrived = true;
1173 }
1174 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
1175}

1177Result<FanOutReceipt> RTS::suppressArea(std::span<const SubjectRef> subjects,
1178 WorldPosition start, WorldPosition end,
1179 float width, int shotsPerUnit) const {
1180 if (!std::isfinite(start.x) || !std::isfinite(start.y) || !std::isfinite(end.x) ||
1181 !std::isfinite(end.y) || !std::isfinite(width) || width <= 0.0f || shotsPerUnit < 0 ||
1182 std::hypot(end.x - start.x, end.y - start.y) <= 1e-3f)
1183 return failure<FanOutReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
1184 "RTS suppression requires a non-degenerate corridor, positive width, and non-negative shots",
1185 "suppression");
1186 std::vector<Unit*> units;
1187 units.reserve(subjects.size());
1188 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < subjects.size(); ++index) {
1189 auto* unit = findUnit(subjects[index]);
1190 if (unit == nullptr)
1191 return failure<FanOutReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
1192 "RTS suppression unit identity was not found", "subjects[" + std::to_string(index) + "]");
1193 if (!unit->durability()->alive || unit->containment()->container.isBound() ||
1194 unit->weapon()->link.resolve() == nullptr)
1195 return failure<FanOutReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
1196 "RTS suppression unit must be alive, deployed, and armed",
1197 "subjects[" + std::to_string(index) + "]");
1198 units.push_back(unit);
1199 }
1200 CommandSpec command;
1201 command.kind = OrderKind::SuppressArea;
1202 command.target = start;
1203 command.secondaryTarget = end;
1204 command.radius = width;
1205 auto issued = commandUnits(subjects, command);
1206 if (!issued) return issued;
1207 for (auto* unit : units) {
1208 unit->artillery()->suppressionShotsRemaining = shotsPerUnit == 0 ? -1 : shotsPerUnit;
1209 unit->artillery()->fireSupportRequester = {};
1210 }
1211 return issued;
1212}
1213
1214Result<FanOutReceipt> RTS::escortUnits(std::span<const SubjectRef> subjects,
1215 SubjectRef protectedSubject,
1216 float guardRadius, float spacing) const {
1217 if (!std::isfinite(guardRadius) || !std::isfinite(spacing) || guardRadius <= 0.0f || spacing <= 0.0f)
1218 return failure<FanOutReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
1219 "RTS escort guard radius and spacing must be finite and positive", "escort");
1220 ecs::Entity* protectedEntity = findUnit(protectedSubject);
1221 if (protectedEntity == nullptr) protectedEntity = findBuilding(protectedSubject);
1222 ecs::Entity* protectedFaction = nullptr;
1223 WorldPosition center{};
1224 float protectedRadius = 0.0f;
1225 if (auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(protectedEntity);
1226 unit != nullptr && unit->durability()->alive && !unit->containment()->container.isBound()) {
1227 protectedFaction = unit->faction()->link.resolve();
1228 center = {unit->motion()->x, unit->motion()->y};
1229 protectedRadius = unit->crowd()->radius;
1230 } else if (auto* building = dynamic_cast<Building*>(protectedEntity);
1231 building != nullptr && building->integrity()->alive) {
1232 protectedFaction = building->faction()->link.resolve();
1233 center = {building->placement()->worldX, building->placement()->worldY};
1234 } else {
1235 return failure<FanOutReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
1236 "RTS escort target must be a live deployed unit or building", "protectedSubject");
1237 }
1238 if (protectedFaction == nullptr)
1239 return failure<FanOutReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
1240 "RTS escort target must have an owning faction", "protectedSubject");
1241
1242 std::vector<Unit*> escorts;
1243 escorts.reserve(subjects.size());
1244 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < subjects.size(); ++index) {
1245 auto* unit = findUnit(subjects[index]);
1246 if (unit == nullptr)
1247 return failure<FanOutReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
1248 "RTS escort unit identity was not found", "subjects[" + std::to_string(index) + "]");
1249 if (unit == protectedEntity || !unit->durability()->alive || unit->containment()->container.isBound() ||
1250 !FactionRelationSystem::isAllied(dynamic_cast<Faction*>(unit->faction()->link.resolve()),
1251 dynamic_cast<Faction*>(protectedFaction)))
1252 return failure<FanOutReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
1253 "RTS escort units must be live, deployed, friendly, and distinct from the target",
1254 "subjects[" + std::to_string(index) + "]");
1255 escorts.push_back(unit);
1256 }
1257 std::sort(escorts.begin(), escorts.end(), [](Unit* left, Unit* right) {
1258 return left->identity()->subject.format() < right->identity()->subject.format();
1259 });
1260 std::vector<SubjectRef> orderedSubjects;
1261 orderedSubjects.reserve(escorts.size());
1262 for (auto* unit : escorts) orderedSubjects.push_back(unit->identity()->subject);
1263 CommandSpec command;
1264 command.kind = OrderKind::Escort;
1265 command.target = center;
1266 command.targetEntity = ecs::handle_of(protectedEntity);
1267 auto issued = commandUnits(orderedSubjects, command);
1268 if (!issued) return issued;
1269 constexpr float tau = 2.0f * static_cast<float>(std::numbers::pi);
1270 for (std::size_t index = 0; index < escorts.size(); ++index) {
1271 const float angle = tau * static_cast<float>(index) / static_cast<float>(escorts.size());
1272 const float distance = protectedRadius + escorts[index]->crowd()->radius + spacing;
1273 escorts[index]->tactics()->escortOffsetX = std::cos(angle) * distance;
1274 escorts[index]->tactics()->escortOffsetY = std::sin(angle) * distance;
1275 escorts[index]->tactics()->protectionRange = guardRadius;
1276 escorts[index]->combat()->leashRange = guardRadius;
1277 }
1278 return issued;
1279}

1281Value RTS::inspectState() const {
1282 Value::Array units;
1283 for (const auto& handle : units_) {
1284 auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(handle));
1285 if (unit == nullptr) continue;
1286 std::string faction;
1287 if (auto* owner = dynamic_cast<Faction*>(unit->faction()->link.resolve()); owner != nullptr)
1288 faction = owner->identity()->subject.format();
1289 std::string order = "idle";
1290 auto current = unit->orders()->values.current();
1291 if (current) order = orderKindName(std::move(current).takeValue().kind);
1292 auto* resourceNode = dynamic_cast<ResourceNode*>(unit->worker()->resourceNode.resolve());
1293 auto* dropoff = dynamic_cast<Building*>(unit->worker()->dropoff.resolve());
1294 int reserveAmmo = 0;
1295 int reserveAmmoCapacity = 0;
1296 if (auto* weaponEntity = dynamic_cast<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(unit->weapon()->link.resolve())) {
1297 const auto& resource = weaponEntity->state()->resource;
1298 if (resource.kind == weapon::ResourceKind::Ammo && !resource.infinite) {
1299 if (auto* pool = weaponEntity->state()->ammoPool) {
1300 reserveAmmo = pool->state()->count;
1301 reserveAmmoCapacity = pool->state()->max;
1302 } else {
1303 reserveAmmo = resource.reserve;
1304 reserveAmmoCapacity = weaponEntity->definition()->def == nullptr
1305 ? resource.reserve : weaponEntity->definition()->def->reserveSize;
1306 }
1307 }
1308 }
1309 units.emplace_back(Value::Object{
1310 {"subject", unit->identity()->subject.format()},
1311 {"definition", unit->definition()->id.format()},
1312 {"faction", std::move(faction)},
1313 {"x", unit->motion()->x},
1314 {"y", unit->motion()->y},
1315 {"airborne", unit->motion()->airborne},
1316 {"order", std::move(order)},
1317 {"queuedOrders", static_cast<std::int64_t>(unit->orders()->values.orderCount())},
1318 {"stance", combatStanceName(unit->combat()->stance)},
1319 {"leashRange", unit->combat()->leashRange},
1320 {"movementPriority", unit->navigation()->movementPriority},
1321 {"trafficWaiting", unit->navigation()->trafficWaiting},
1322 {"cloaked", unit->vision()->cloaked},
1323 {"health", unit->durability()->state.health},
1324 {"maxHealth", unit->durability()->state.maxHealth},
1325 {"shield", unit->shield()->value},
1326 {"maxShield", unit->shield()->capacity},
1327 {"experience", unit->veterancy()->experience},
1328 {"veterancyLevel", static_cast<std::int64_t>(unit->veterancy()->level)},
1329 {"activeEffects", static_cast<std::int64_t>(unit->effects()->values.count())},
1330 {"inCommand", unit->command()->inCommand},
1331 {"garrisoned", unit->containment()->container.resolve() != nullptr},
1332 {"resourceType", unit->worker()->resourceType},
1333 {"cargo", unit->worker()->cargo},
1334 {"cargoCapacity", unit->worker()->capacity},
1335 {"autoAssign", unit->worker()->autoAssign},
1336 {"resourceNode", resourceNode == nullptr ? std::string{} : resourceNode->identity()->subject.format()},
1337 {"dropoff", dropoff == nullptr ? std::string{} : dropoff->identity()->subject.format()},
1338 {"reserveAmmo", static_cast<std::int64_t>(reserveAmmo)},
1339 {"reserveAmmoCapacity", static_cast<std::int64_t>(reserveAmmoCapacity)},
1340 {"supplyStock", unit->supply()->stock},
1341 {"supplyCapacity", unit->supply()->capacity},
1342 {"autoResupply", unit->supply()->autoDispatch},
1343 {"reservedSupply", unit->supply()->reservedStock},
1344 {"supplyReturning", unit->supply()->returning},
1345 });
1346 }
1347
1348 Value::Array buildings;
1349 for (const auto& handle : buildings_) {
1350 auto* building = dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(handle));
1351 if (building == nullptr) continue;
1352 std::string faction;
1353 if (auto* owner = dynamic_cast<Faction*>(building->faction()->link.resolve()); owner != nullptr)
1354 faction = owner->identity()->subject.format();
1355 buildings.emplace_back(Value::Object{
1356 {"subject", building->identity()->subject.format()},
1357 {"definition", building->definition()->id.format()},
1358 {"faction", std::move(faction)},
1359 {"x", building->placement()->worldX},
1360 {"y", building->placement()->worldY},
1361 {"complete", building->construction()->progress >= 1.0f},
1362 {"progress", building->construction()->progress},
1363 {"powered", building->infrastructure()->powered},
1364 {"productionQueue", static_cast<std::int64_t>(building->production()->values.taskCount())},
1365 {"health", building->integrity()->state.health},
1366 {"maxHealth", building->integrity()->state.maxHealth},
1367 {"shield", building->shield()->value},
1368 {"maxShield", building->shield()->capacity},
1369 {"activeEffects", static_cast<std::int64_t>(building->effects()->values.count())},
1370 {"supplyStock", building->supply()->stock},
1371 {"supplyCapacity", building->supply()->capacity},
1372 });
1373 }
1374
1375 Value::Array resourceNodes;
1376 for (const auto& handle : resourceNodes_) {
1377 auto* node = dynamic_cast<ResourceNode*>(ecs::try_get(handle));
1378 if (node == nullptr) continue;
1379 resourceNodes.emplace_back(Value::Object{
1380 {"subject", node->identity()->subject.format()},
1381 {"resource", node->stock()->resourceType},
1382 {"remaining", node->stock()->remaining},
1383 {"maximum", node->stock()->maximum},
1384 {"x", node->position()->x},
1385 {"y", node->position()->y},
1386 {"capacity", static_cast<std::int64_t>(node->harvest()->capacity)},
1387 {"workers", static_cast<std::int64_t>(node->harvest()->workers.size())},
1388 });
1389 }
1390
1391 Value::Array factions;
1392 for (const auto& handle : factions_) {
1393 auto* faction = dynamic_cast<Faction*>(ecs::try_get(handle));
1394 if (faction == nullptr) continue;
1395 factions.emplace_back(Value::Object{
1396 {"subject", faction->identity()->subject.format()},
1397 {"displayName", faction->identity()->displayName},
1398 {"units", static_cast<std::int64_t>(faction->members()->units.size())},
1399 {"buildings", static_cast<std::int64_t>(faction->members()->buildings.size())},
1400 {"autoConstruction", faction->workforce()->autoConstruction},
1401 {"autoRepair", faction->workforce()->autoRepair},
1402 {"maxBuildersPerSite", static_cast<std::int64_t>(faction->workforce()->maxBuildersPerSite)},
1403 {"maxRepairersPerBuilding",
1404 static_cast<std::int64_t>(faction->workforce()->maxRepairersPerBuilding)},
1405 {"reserveWorkers", static_cast<std::int64_t>(faction->workforce()->reserveWorkers)},
1406 });
1407 }
1408
1409 return Value(Value::Object{
1410 {"units", Value(std::move(units))},
1411 {"buildings", Value(std::move(buildings))},
1412 {"resourceNodes", Value(std::move(resourceNodes))},
1413 {"factions", Value(std::move(factions))},
1414 });
1415}

1417Value RTS::inspectFrameEvents() const {
1418 const auto channelName = [](DamageChannel channel) {
1419 switch (channel) {
1420 case DamageChannel::Ability: return "ability";
1421 case DamageChannel::Projectile: return "projectile";
1422 case DamageChannel::Weapon: return "weapon";
1423 }
1424 return "weapon";
1425 };
1426 const auto reactionName = [](combat::HitReaction reaction) {
1427 switch (reaction) {
1428 case combat::HitReaction::None: return "none";
1429 case combat::HitReaction::Flinch: return "flinch";
1430 case combat::HitReaction::Stagger: return "stagger";
1431 case combat::HitReaction::Knockdown: return "knockdown";
1432 case combat::HitReaction::Death: return "death";
1433 }
1434 return "none";
1435 };
1436 std::vector<std::pair<std::uint64_t, Value>> sequenced;
1437 sequenced.reserve(frameDamageEvents_.size() + frameCombatEvents_.size() + frameLifecycleEvents_.size());
1438 for (const auto& event : frameDamageEvents_) {
1439 sequenced.emplace_back(event.sequence, Value(Value::Object{
1440 {"type", "damage"},
1441 {"tick", static_cast<std::int64_t>(event.tick.value())},
1442 {"channel", channelName(event.channel)},
1443 {"source", event.outcome.source.format()},
1444 {"target", event.outcome.target.format()},
1445 {"damageType", event.request.damageType},
1446 {"previousHealth", event.outcome.previousHealth},
1447 {"health", event.outcome.health},
1448 {"appliedHealthDamage", event.outcome.appliedHealthDamage},
1449 {"appliedPoiseDamage", event.outcome.appliedPoiseDamage},
1450 {"reaction", reactionName(event.outcome.reaction)},
1451 {"killed", event.outcome.reaction == combat::HitReaction::Death},
1452 }));
1453 }
1454 const auto fireType = [](CombatFireEventKind kind) {
1455 switch (kind) {
1456 case CombatFireEventKind::WeaponFired: return "weapon_fired";
1457 case CombatFireEventKind::ProjectileFired: return "projectile_fired";
1458 case CombatFireEventKind::ShotMissed: return "shot_missed";
1459 case CombatFireEventKind::ReloadStarted: return "reload_started";
1460 case CombatFireEventKind::ReloadCompleted: return "reload_completed";
1461 case CombatFireEventKind::WeaponDry: return "weapon_dry";
1462 case CombatFireEventKind::FireBlocked: return "fire_blocked";
1463 }
1464 return "weapon_fired";
1465 };
1466 for (const auto& value : frameCombatEvents_)
1467 sequenced.emplace_back(value.sequence, Value(Value::Object{
1468 {"type", fireType(value.event.kind)},
1469 {"tick", static_cast<std::int64_t>(value.tick.value())},
1470 {"source", value.event.source.format()},
1471 {"target", value.event.target.format()},
1472 {"x", value.event.point.x}, {"y", value.event.point.y},
1473 }));
1474 const auto lifecycleType = [](LifecycleEventKind kind) {
1475 switch (kind) {
1476 case LifecycleEventKind::SuppressionRecovered: return "suppression_recovered";
1477 case LifecycleEventKind::ShieldRecharged: return "shield_recharged";
1478 case LifecycleEventKind::ConstructionCompleted: return "construction_completed";
1479 case LifecycleEventKind::ProductionSpawnBlocked: return "production_spawn_blocked";
1480 case LifecycleEventKind::ProductionSpawnCleared: return "production_spawn_cleared";
1481 case LifecycleEventKind::UnitProduced: return "unit_produced";
1482 case LifecycleEventKind::BuildingCaptured: return "building_captured";
1483 case LifecycleEventKind::AbilityCast: return "ability_cast";
1484 case LifecycleEventKind::AbilityChannelStarted: return "ability_channel_started";
1485 case LifecycleEventKind::AbilityChannelTick: return "ability_channel_tick";
1486 case LifecycleEventKind::AbilityChannelCompleted: return "ability_channel_completed";
1487 case LifecycleEventKind::AbilityInterrupted: return "ability_interrupted";
1488 case LifecycleEventKind::AbilityChannelCancelled: return "ability_channel_cancelled";
1489 case LifecycleEventKind::StatusApplied: return "status_applied";
1490 case LifecycleEventKind::StatusExpired: return "status_expired";
1491 case LifecycleEventKind::AmmoProduced: return "ammo_produced";
1492 case LifecycleEventKind::SupplyDispatched: return "supply_dispatched";
1493 case LifecycleEventKind::SupplyRelayDispatched: return "supply_rendezvous_dispatched";
1494 case LifecycleEventKind::AmmoResupplied: return "ammo_resupplied";
1495 case LifecycleEventKind::SupplyRelayTransferred: return "supply_relay_transferred";
1496 case LifecycleEventKind::SupplyReturning: return "supply_returning";
1497 case LifecycleEventKind::SupplyReturned: return "supply_returned";
1498 }
1499 return "lifecycle";
1500 };
1501 for (const auto& value : frameLifecycleEvents_)
1502 sequenced.emplace_back(value.sequence, Value(Value::Object{
1503 {"type", lifecycleType(value.event.kind)},
1504 {"tick", static_cast<std::int64_t>(value.tick.value())},
1505 {"source", value.event.source.format()},
1506 {"target", value.event.target.format()},
1507 {"detail", value.event.detail},
1508 {"value", value.event.value},
1509 }));
1510 std::sort(sequenced.begin(), sequenced.end(),
1511 [](const auto& left, const auto& right) { return left.first < right.first; });
1512 Value::Array events;
1513 events.reserve(sequenced.size());
1514 for (auto& [sequence, value] : sequenced) {
1515 (void)sequence;
1516 events.push_back(std::move(value));
1517 }
1518 return Value(std::move(events));
1519}

1563Result<double> RTS::heal(SubjectRef source, SubjectRef target, double amount) const {
1564 if (!source.isValid() || !target.isValid() || !std::isfinite(amount) || amount <= 0.0)
1565 return failure<double>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
1566 "RTS healing requires valid subjects and a finite positive amount", "healing");
1567 if (!ownsSubject(source))
1568 return failure<double>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound, "RTS healing source was not found", "source");
1569 combat::CombatState* state = nullptr;
1570 bool* alive = nullptr;
1571 if (auto* unit = findUnit(target)) {
1572 state = &unit->durability()->state;
1573 alive = &unit->durability()->alive;
1574 } else if (auto* building = findBuilding(target)) {
1575 state = &building->integrity()->state;
1576 alive = &building->integrity()->alive;
1577 } else {
1578 return failure<double>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound, "RTS healing target was not found", "target");
1579 }
1580 if (!*alive || state->health <= 0.0)
1581 return failure<double>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict, "RTS healing target must be alive", "target");
1582 auto valid = state->validate();
1583 if (!valid) return Result<double>::failure(valid.status());
1584 const double applied = std::min(amount, state->maxHealth - state->health);
1585 state->health += applied;
1586 return Result<double>::success(applied,
1587 Status::success(applied == 0.0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
1588}
1589
1590Result<effects::EffectHandle> RTS::applyStatusEffect(
1591 SubjectRef source, SubjectRef target, std::string effect, double durationOverride) {
1592 if (definitions_ == nullptr)
1593 return failure<effects::EffectHandle>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
1594 "RTS status effects require a definition registry", "definitions");
1595 if (!ownsSubject(source))
1596 return failure<effects::EffectHandle>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
1597 "RTS status-effect source was not found", "source");
1598 auto definition = resolveEffectDefinition(*definitions_, effect, source, durationOverride);
1599 if (!definition) return Result<effects::EffectHandle>::failure(definition.status());
1600 if (auto* unit = findUnit(target)) {
1601 if (!unit->durability()->alive)
1602 return failure<effects::EffectHandle>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
1603 "RTS status-effect target must be alive", "target");
1604 auto applied = applyEffect(*unit, definition.value());
1605 if (applied)
1606 recordLifecycleEvent({LifecycleEventKind::StatusApplied, source, target, effect,
1607 definition.value().duration}, SimulationTick(scriptTick()));
1608 return applied;
1609 }
1610 if (auto* building = findBuilding(target)) {
1611 if (!building->integrity()->alive)
1612 return failure<effects::EffectHandle>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
1613 "RTS status-effect target must be alive", "target");
1614 auto applied = applyEffect(*building, definition.value());
1615 if (applied)
1616 recordLifecycleEvent({LifecycleEventKind::StatusApplied, source, target, effect,
1617 definition.value().duration}, SimulationTick(scriptTick()));
1618 return applied;
1619 }
1620 return failure<effects::EffectHandle>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
1621 "RTS status-effect target was not found", "target");
1622}

1624Result<RTSBuildReceipt> RTS::build(Building& building, action::ActionRuntime& action,
1625 resource::IResourceAccount& account, resource::CostSpec cost, std::string product,
1626 Duration duration, std::string productionKind, int priority,
1627 std::string transactionId) {
1628 if (!owns(buildings_, building))
1629 return Result<RTSBuildReceipt>::failure(
1630 Diagnostic::error(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle, "RTS Building does not belong to this facade", "building"));
1631 std::vector<RTSProductionResourceReserve> reserves;
1632 if (auto* faction = dynamic_cast<Faction*>(building.faction()->link.resolve()); faction != nullptr) {
1633 reserves.reserve(faction->productionPolicy()->resourceReserves.size());
1634 for (const auto& [resource, policy] : faction->productionPolicy()->resourceReserves) {
1635 auto item = resource::ResourceCost::create(resource, policy.amount);
1636 if (!item) return Result<RTSBuildReceipt>::failure(item.status());
1637 reserves.push_back({std::move(item).takeValue(), policy.minimumPriority});
1638 }
1639 }
1640 return RTSProductionActionAdapter::build(building, action, account, std::move(cost), std::move(product),
1641 std::move(duration), std::move(productionKind), priority,
1642 std::move(transactionId), std::move(reserves));
1643}
1644
1645Result<void> RTS::setProductionResourceReserve(
1646 Faction& faction, std::string resource, std::int64_t amount, int minimumPriority) {
1647 if (!owns(factions_, faction))
1648 return Result<void>::failure(Diagnostic::error(
1649 DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle, "RTS Faction does not belong to this facade", "faction"));
1650 if (resource.empty() || amount < 0)
1651 return Result<void>::failure(Diagnostic::error(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
1652 "RTS production resource reserve requires a resource and non-negative amount", "reserve"));
1653 if (amount == 0) {
1654 faction.productionPolicy()->resourceReserves.erase(resource);
1655 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
1656 }
1657 auto valid = resource::ResourceCost::create(resource, amount);
1658 if (!valid) return Result<void>::failure(valid.status());
1659 faction.productionPolicy()->resourceReserves[std::move(resource)] = {amount, minimumPriority};
1660 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
1661}

1663Result<RTSCancelProductionReceipt> RTS::cancelProduction(

1670 return RTSProductionActionAdapter::cancel(building, account, std::move(productionTaskId),
1671 std::move(orderId), std::move(refund), std::move(reason));
