1674Result<std::size_t> RTS::step(const SimulationStep& simulationStep, IRTSActionExecutor& executor) {
1675 if (!preserveFrameEventsOnNextStep_) {
1676 frameDamageEvents_.clear();
1677 frameCombatEvents_.clear();
1678 frameLifecycleEvents_.clear();
1679 frameEventSequence_ = 0;
1680 }
1681 preserveFrameEventsOnNextStep_ = false;
1682 const DamageEventSink damageEvents = [this](const combat::DamageRequest& request,
1683 const combat::DamageOutcome& outcome,
1684 SimulationTick tick, DamageChannel channel) {
1685 recordDamageEvent(request, outcome, tick, channel);
1686 };
1687 const CombatFireEventSink fireEvents = [this](const CombatFireEvent& event, SimulationTick tick) {
1688 recordCombatEvent(event, tick);
1689 };
1690 const LifecycleEventSink lifecycleEvents = [this](const LifecycleEvent& event, SimulationTick tick) {
1691 recordLifecycleEvent(event, tick);
1692 };
1693 auto assignments = WorkerAssignmentSystem::step();
1694 if (!assignments) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(assignments.status());
1695 std::size_t processed = std::move(assignments).takeValue();
1696
1697 auto workforce = WorkforceAssignmentSystem::step();
1698 if (!workforce) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(workforce.status());
1699 processed += std::move(workforce).takeValue();
1700
1701 auto ai = AISystem::step(simulationStep, aiProductionRequest_);
1702 if (!ai) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(ai.status());
1703 processed += std::move(ai).takeValue();
1704
1705 auto tactics = TacticsSystem::step(damage_, simulationStep);
1706 if (!tactics) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(tactics.status());
1707 processed += std::move(tactics).takeValue();
1708
1709 auto command = CommandNetworkSystem::step();
1710 if (!command) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(command.status());
1711 processed += std::move(command).takeValue();
1712
1713 auto commandState = CommandStateSystem::step();
1714 if (!commandState) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(commandState.status());
1715 processed += std::move(commandState).takeValue();
1716
1717 auto patrol = PatrolSystem::step();
1718 if (!patrol) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(patrol.status());
1719 processed += std::move(patrol).takeValue();
1720
1721 if (pathfinder_ != nullptr) {
1722 auto navigation = NavigationSystem::step(*pathfinder_, navigationGrid_, navigationEvent_);
1723 if (!navigation) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(navigation.status());
1724 processed += std::move(navigation).takeValue();
1725 auto traffic = TrafficReservationSystem::step(*pathfinder_, navigationGrid_);
1726 if (!traffic) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(traffic.status());
1727 processed += std::move(traffic).takeValue();
1728 }
1729
1730 auto convoy = SupplyConvoySystem::step();
1731 if (!convoy) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(convoy.status());
1732 processed += std::move(convoy).takeValue();
1733
1734 if (fogProvider_) {
1735 auto fog = FogOfWarSystem::step(simulationStep, navigationGrid_, fogState_, fogProvider_);
1736 if (!fog) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(fog.status());
1737 processed += std::move(fog).takeValue();
1738 }
1739
1740 auto motion = MotionSystem::step(simulationStep);
1741 if (!motion) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(motion.status());
1742 processed += std::move(motion).takeValue();
1743
1744 if (crowd_ != nullptr) {
1745 auto crowdMotion = CrowdMotionSystem::step(simulationStep, *crowd_);
1746 if (!crowdMotion) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(crowdMotion.status());
1747 processed += std::move(crowdMotion).takeValue();
1748 }
1749
1750 auto movementOrders = MovementOrderSystem::step();
1751 if (!movementOrders) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(movementOrders.status());
1752 processed += std::move(movementOrders).takeValue();
1753
1754 auto containment = ContainmentSystem::step();
1755 if (!containment) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(containment.status());
1756 processed += std::move(containment).takeValue();
1757
1758 auto morale = MoraleSystem::step(simulationStep, lifecycleEvents);
1759 if (!morale) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(morale.status());
1760 processed += std::move(morale).takeValue();
1761
1762 auto shields = ShieldSystem::step(simulationStep, lifecycleEvents);
1763 if (!shields) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(shields.status());
1764 processed += std::move(shields).takeValue();
1765
1766 auto supply = SupplySystem::step(simulationStep, ammoProductionPurchase_, pathfinder_, navigationGrid_,
1767 [this](const LifecycleEvent& event, SimulationTick tick) { recordLifecycleEvent(event, tick); });
1768 if (!supply) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(supply.status());
1769 processed += std::move(supply).takeValue();
1770
1771 auto artillery = ArtillerySystem::step(simulationStep);
1772 if (!artillery) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(artillery.status());
1773 processed += std::move(artillery).takeValue();
1774
1775 auto fireSupport = FireSupportSystem::step(simulationStep);
1776 if (!fireSupport) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(fireSupport.status());
1777 processed += std::move(fireSupport).takeValue();
1778
1779 if (resourceCredit_) {
1780 auto mining = MiningSystem::step(simulationStep, resourceCredit_);
1781 if (!mining) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(mining.status());
1782 processed += std::move(mining).takeValue();
1783 }
1784
1785 auto construction = ConstructionSystem::step(simulationStep, lifecycleEvents);
1786 if (!construction) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(construction.status());
1787 processed += std::move(construction).takeValue();
1788
1789 auto infrastructure = InfrastructureSystem::step(simulationStep, passiveIncomeCredit_);
1790 if (!infrastructure) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(infrastructure.status());
1791 processed += std::move(infrastructure).takeValue();
1792
1793 if (repairDebit_) {
1794 auto repair = RepairSystem::step(simulationStep, repairDebit_);
1795 if (!repair) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(repair.status());
1796 processed += std::move(repair).takeValue();
1797 }
1798
1799 auto capture = CaptureSystem::step(simulationStep, lifecycleEvents);
1800 if (!capture) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(capture.status());
1801 processed += std::move(capture).takeValue();
1802
1803 if (damage_ != nullptr) {
1804 auto abilities = AbilitySystem::step(simulationStep, *damage_, damageEvents, lifecycleEvents);
1805 if (!abilities) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(abilities.status());
1806 processed += std::move(abilities).takeValue();
1807 auto projectileImpacts = projectiles_.step(
1808 simulationStep, *damage_, projectileCollisionQuery_, damageEvents);
1809 if (!projectileImpacts) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(projectileImpacts.status());
1810 processed += std::move(projectileImpacts).takeValue();
1811 }
1812 if (sensing_ != nullptr && damage_ != nullptr) {
1813 auto combat = CombatFireSystem::step(simulationStep, combatState_, *sensing_, *damage_, &projectiles_,
1814 fireLineQuery_, pathfinder_, navigationGrid_, combatHeightQuery_,
1815 damageEvents, fireEvents);
1816 if (!combat) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(combat.status());
1817 processed += std::move(combat).takeValue();
1818 }
1819
1820 auto actions = OrderActionSystem::step(simulationStep, executor);
1821 if (!actions) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(actions.status());
1822 processed += std::move(actions).takeValue();
1823
1824 auto reinforcementPolicy = ReinforcementProductionPolicySystem::step(simulationStep, reinforcementCancel_);
1825 if (!reinforcementPolicy) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(reinforcementPolicy.status());
1826 processed += std::move(reinforcementPolicy).takeValue();
1827
1828 auto production = BuildingProductionSystem::step(
1829 simulationStep, productionSpawn_, productionSpawnPosition_, lifecycleEvents);
1830 if (!production) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(production.status());
1831 processed += std::move(production).takeValue();
1832 for (const auto& handle : units_) {
1833 auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(handle));
1834 if (unit == nullptr || unit->attributes()->values.initialized()) continue;
1835 auto initialized = RTSUnitAttributeAdapter::ensure(*unit);
1836 if (!initialized) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(initialized.status());
1837 }
1838
1839 auto reinforcements = ReinforcementSystem::step();
1840 if (!reinforcements) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(reinforcements.status());
1841 processed += std::move(reinforcements).takeValue();
1842 if (definitions_ != nullptr) {
1843 auto technology = TechnologySystem::step(*definitions_);
1844 if (!technology) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(technology.status());
1845 processed += std::move(technology).takeValue();
1846 }
1847
1848 auto effects = EffectSystem::step(simulationStep, lifecycleEvents);
1849 if (!effects) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(effects.status());
1850 processed += std::move(effects).takeValue();
1851 for (const auto& handle : matches_) {
1852 auto* match = dynamic_cast<Match*>(ecs::try_get(handle));
1853 if (match == nullptr) continue;
1854 auto outcome = MatchSystem::step(*match, matchResourceQuery_);
1855 if (!outcome) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(outcome.status());
1856 processed += std::move(outcome).takeValue();
1857 }
1858 auto cleanup = cleanupDestroyed();
1859 if (!cleanup) return failureFrom<std::size_t>(cleanup.status());
1860 processed += std::move(cleanup).takeValue();
1861 return Result<std::size_t>::success(processed, Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
1862}
1863
1864Result<std::size_t> RTS::stepScript(double seconds) {
1865 auto duration = Duration::fromSeconds(seconds);
1866 if (!duration || seconds <= 0.0) {
1867 if (!duration) return Result<std::size_t>::failure(duration.status());
1868 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
1869 "RTS script step duration must be positive", "seconds");
1870 }
1871 if (!scriptRuntime_) scriptRuntime_ = std::make_unique<ScriptRuntime>();
1872 if (scriptRuntime_->nextTick == std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max())
1873 return failure<std::size_t>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict, "RTS script simulation tick overflow", "tick");
1874 const SimulationTick tick{scriptRuntime_->nextTick++};
1875 frameDamageEvents_.clear();
1876 frameCombatEvents_.clear();
1877 frameLifecycleEvents_.clear();
1878 frameEventSequence_ = 0;
1879 preserveFrameEventsOnNextStep_ = true;
1880 auto commands = scriptRuntime_->commandLog.apply(tick, *this);
1881 if (!commands) {
1882 preserveFrameEventsOnNextStep_ = false;
1883 return failureFrom<std::size_t>(commands.status());
1884 }
1885 const SimulationStep simulationStep{tick, std::move(duration).takeValue()};
1886 auto stepped = step(simulationStep, scriptRuntime_->adapter);
1887 if (!stepped) return stepped;
1888 std::erase_if(scriptRuntime_->paidProduction, [this](const auto& record) {
1889 auto* producer = findBuilding(record.producer);
1890 if (producer == nullptr) return true;
1891 auto task = producer->production()->values.find(record.taskId);
1892 return !task || task->get().state == production::TaskState::Completed ||
1893 task->get().state == production::TaskState::Cancelled ||
1894 task->get().state == production::TaskState::Failed;
1895 });
1896 return Result<std::size_t>::success(commands.value() + stepped.value(), Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
1897}
1898
1899Result<void> RTS::configureScriptWorld(int width, int height, float cellSize, float originX, float originY) {
1900 if (width <= 0 || height <= 0 || !std::isfinite(cellSize) || cellSize <= 0.0f ||
1901 !std::isfinite(originX) || !std::isfinite(originY))
1902 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
1903 "RTS script world requires positive dimensions and finite grid geometry", "grid");
1904 if (!scriptRuntime_) scriptRuntime_ = std::make_unique<ScriptRuntime>();
1905 scriptRuntime_->pathfinder.setSize(width, height);
1906 scriptRuntime_->crowd.resizeField(width, height, cellSize, originX, originY);
1907 scriptRuntime_->width = width;
1908 scriptRuntime_->height = height;
1909 scriptRuntime_->cellSize = cellSize;
1910 scriptRuntime_->originX = originX;
1911 scriptRuntime_->originY = originY;
1912 scriptRuntime_->terrainElevations.assign(static_cast<std::size_t>(width * height), 0.0f);
1913 scriptRuntime_->commandLog.clear();
1914 scriptRuntime_->nextTick = 1;
1915 scriptRuntime_->aiProductionSequence = 1;
1916 scriptRuntime_->configured = true;
1917 setDefinitionRegistry(&scriptRuntime_->definitions);
1918 setNavigationProvider(&scriptRuntime_->pathfinder, {cellSize, originX, originY});
1919 setCrowdProvider(&scriptRuntime_->crowd);
1920 setCombatProviders(&scriptRuntime_->sensing, &scriptRuntime_->damage);
1921 const auto firstBlockedPoint = [this](WorldPosition from, WorldPosition to) -> std::optional<WorldPosition> {
1922 if (!scriptRuntime_ || !scriptRuntime_->configured) return std::nullopt;
1923 const float dx = to.x - from.x;
1924 const float dy = to.y - from.y;
1925 const float distance = std::hypot(dx, dy);
1926 const float sampleLength = std::max(scriptRuntime_->cellSize * 0.25f, 0.001f);
1927 const int samples = std::max(1, static_cast<int>(std::ceil(distance / sampleLength)));
1928 int previousX = static_cast<int>(std::floor((from.x - scriptRuntime_->originX) /
1929 scriptRuntime_->cellSize));
1930 int previousY = static_cast<int>(std::floor((from.y - scriptRuntime_->originY) /
1931 scriptRuntime_->cellSize));
1932 for (int sample = 1; sample <= samples; ++sample) {
1933 const float t = static_cast<float>(sample) / static_cast<float>(samples);
1934 const WorldPosition point{from.x + dx * t, from.y + dy * t};
1935 const int cellX = static_cast<int>(std::floor((point.x - scriptRuntime_->originX) /
1936 scriptRuntime_->cellSize));
1937 const int cellY = static_cast<int>(std::floor((point.y - scriptRuntime_->originY) /
1938 scriptRuntime_->cellSize));
1939 if (cellX == previousX && cellY == previousY) continue;
1940 previousX = cellX;
1941 previousY = cellY;
1942 if (cellX < 0 || cellY < 0 || cellX >= scriptRuntime_->width || cellY >= scriptRuntime_->height ||
1943 !scriptRuntime_->pathfinder.isWalkable(cellX, cellY))
1944 return point;
1945 }
1946 return std::nullopt;
1947 };
1948 const auto terrainAt = [this](WorldPosition point) {
1949 if (!scriptRuntime_ || scriptRuntime_->terrainElevations.empty()) return 0.0f;
1950 const int x = static_cast<int>(std::floor((point.x - scriptRuntime_->originX) /
1951 scriptRuntime_->cellSize));
1952 const int y = static_cast<int>(std::floor((point.y - scriptRuntime_->originY) /
1953 scriptRuntime_->cellSize));
1954 if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= scriptRuntime_->width || y >= scriptRuntime_->height) return 0.0f;
1955 return scriptRuntime_->terrainElevations[static_cast<std::size_t>(y * scriptRuntime_->width + x)];
1956 };
1957 const auto relativeHeight = [](ecs::EntityHandle handle, bool firing) {
1958 if (auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(handle)))
1959 return firing ? unit->combat()->firingHeight : unit->combat()->targetHeight;
1960 if (auto* building = dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(handle)))
1961 return firing ? building->combat()->firingHeight : building->combat()->targetHeight;
1962 return firing ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
1963 };
1964 const auto terrainBlocks = [this, terrainAt](WorldPosition from, WorldPosition to,
1965 float fromHeight, float toHeight) {
1966 const float distance = std::hypot(to.x - from.x, to.y - from.y);
1967 const float sampleLength = std::max(scriptRuntime_->cellSize * 0.25f, 0.001f);
1968 const int samples = std::max(1, static_cast<int>(std::ceil(distance / sampleLength)));
1969 for (int sample = 1; sample < samples; ++sample) {
1970 const float t = static_cast<float>(sample) / static_cast<float>(samples);
1971 const WorldPosition point{from.x + (to.x - from.x) * t, from.y + (to.y - from.y) * t};
1972 if (terrainAt(point) >= fromHeight + (toHeight - fromHeight) * t) return std::optional{point};
1973 }
1974 return std::optional<WorldPosition>{};
1975 };
1976 setFireLineQuery([firstBlockedPoint, terrainAt, relativeHeight, terrainBlocks](
1977 WorldPosition from, WorldPosition to, ecs::EntityHandle source,
1978 ecs::EntityHandle target, const weapon::WeaponDefinition&) -> Result<bool> {
1979 const float sourceHeight = terrainAt(from) + relativeHeight(source, true);
1980 const float targetHeight = terrainAt(to) + relativeHeight(target, false);
1981 const bool blocked = firstBlockedPoint(from, to).has_value() ||
1982 terrainBlocks(from, to, sourceHeight, targetHeight).has_value();
1983 return Result<bool>::success(!blocked,
1984 Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
1985 });
1986 setCombatHeightQuery([terrainAt, relativeHeight](WorldPosition from, WorldPosition to,
1987 ecs::EntityHandle source, ecs::EntityHandle target) {
1988 return CombatHeightProfile{terrainAt(from) + relativeHeight(source, true),
1989 terrainAt(to) + relativeHeight(target, false)};
1990 });
1991 setProjectileCollisionQuery(
1992 [firstBlockedPoint, terrainBlocks](WorldPosition from, float fromHeight,
1993 WorldPosition to, float toHeight, SubjectRef,
1994 ecs::EntityHandle) -> Result<std::optional<ProjectileCollision>> {
1995 const auto blocked = firstBlockedPoint(from, to);
1996 const auto terrainImpact = terrainBlocks(from, to, fromHeight, toHeight);
1997 if (!blocked && !terrainImpact)
1998 return Result<std::optional<ProjectileCollision>>::success(
1999 std::nullopt, Status::success(StatusCode::NoOp));
2000 const WorldPosition impact = blocked ? *blocked : *terrainImpact;
2001 return Result<std::optional<ProjectileCollision>>::success(
2002 ProjectileCollision{impact, {}}, Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
2003 });
2004 setFogProvider([this](Faction& faction) -> map::Fov* {
2005 if (!scriptRuntime_) return nullptr;
2006 const auto found = scriptRuntime_->fovs.find(faction.identity()->subject.format());
2007 return found == scriptRuntime_->fovs.end() ? nullptr : found->second.get();
2008 });
2009 setProductionSpawn([this](Building& producer, const production::ProductionTask& task) -> Result<Unit*> {
2010 if (!scriptRuntime_)
2011 return failure<Unit*>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict, "RTS script runtime is unavailable", "production");
2012 const auto pending = scriptRuntime_->pendingProductionSubjects.find(task.id);
2013 if (pending == scriptRuntime_->pendingProductionSubjects.end())
2014 return failure<Unit*>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
2015 "RTS produced unit has no reserved stable subject", "production.task");
2016 const auto definition = LogicalId::parse("unit:" + task.product);
2017 if (!definition)
2018 return failure<Unit*>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2019 "RTS produced unit has an invalid logical definition", "production.product");
2020 auto* faction = dynamic_cast<Faction*>(producer.faction()->link.resolve());
2021 if (faction == nullptr)
2022 return failure<Unit*>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
2023 "RTS producer faction link is stale", "production.faction");
2024 scriptRuntime_->spawningProduction = true;
2025 auto created = newFactionUnit(*faction, pending->second, *definition);
2026 scriptRuntime_->spawningProduction = false;
2027 if (created) scriptRuntime_->pendingProductionSubjects.erase(pending);
2028 return created;
2029 });
2030 setAIProductionRequest([this](Faction& faction, Building& producer,
2031 const LogicalId& definition) -> Result<void> {
2032 if (!scriptRuntime_ || !scriptRuntime_->configured)
2033 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
2034 "RTS script AI production requires a configured world", "scriptRuntime");
2035 if (scriptRuntime_->aiProductionSequence == std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max())
2036 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
2037 "RTS script AI production identity sequence overflow", "ai.sequence");
2038 SubjectRef generated;
2039 do {
2040 generated = deterministicSubject(
2041 faction.identity()->subject.format() + ":" + producer.identity()->subject.format() +
2042 ":" + definition.format(),
2043 scriptRuntime_->aiProductionSequence++);
2044 } while (ownsSubject(generated) &&
2045 scriptRuntime_->aiProductionSequence != std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max());
2046 if (ownsSubject(generated))
2047 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
2048 "RTS script AI could not allocate a stable production subject", "ai.sequence");
2049 auto queued = queueScriptUnit(producer, generated, definition);
2050 if (!queued) return Result<void>::failure(queued.status());
2051 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
2052 });
2053
2054 for (const auto& handle : factions_) {
2055 auto* faction = dynamic_cast<Faction*>(ecs::try_get(handle));
2056 if (faction == nullptr) continue;
2057 const std::string key = faction->identity()->subject.format();
2058 if (!scriptRuntime_->economies.contains(key))
2059 scriptRuntime_->economies.emplace(key, std::make_unique<ScriptRuntime::EconomySlot>());
2060 auto& fov = scriptRuntime_->fovs[key];
2061 if (!fov) fov = std::make_unique<map::Fov>(width, height);
2062 else fov->setSize(width, height);
2063 fov->setMode("heightmap");
2064 fov->setEyeOffset(1.0f);
2065 fov->setCliffBlock(0.0f);
2066 auto link = EconomyLink::bind("rts/script/economy/" + key);
2067 if (!link) return Result<void>::failure(link.status());
2068 faction->economy()->link = std::move(link).takeValue();
2069 }
2070 for (const auto& handle : units_) {
2071 auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(handle));
2072 if (unit == nullptr) continue;
2073 const std::string key = unit->identity()->subject.format();
2074 auto crowdLink = CrowdLink::bind(key);
2075 auto sensingLink = SensingLink::bind(key);
2076 if (!crowdLink) return Result<void>::failure(crowdLink.status());
2077 if (!sensingLink) return Result<void>::failure(sensingLink.status());
2078 unit->crowd()->link = std::move(crowdLink).takeValue();
2079 unit->sensing()->link = std::move(sensingLink).takeValue();
2080 }
2081
2082 const auto accountForFaction = [this](Faction* faction) -> resource::IResourceAccount* {
2083 if (faction == nullptr || !scriptRuntime_) return nullptr;
2084 const auto found = scriptRuntime_->economies.find(faction->identity()->subject.format());
2085 return found == scriptRuntime_->economies.end() ? nullptr : &found->second->account;
2086 };
2087 setResourceCredit([accountForFaction](Unit& unit, const resource::CostSpec& cost) -> Result<resource::Receipt> {
2088 auto* account = accountForFaction(dynamic_cast<Faction*>(unit.faction()->link.resolve()));
2089 if (account == nullptr)
2090 return failure<resource::Receipt>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
2091 "RTS script faction economy was not found", "unit.faction");
2092 return account->credit(cost);
2093 });
2094 setRepairDebit([accountForFaction](Unit& unit, Building&, const resource::CostSpec& cost)
2095 -> Result<resource::Receipt> {
2096 auto* account = accountForFaction(dynamic_cast<Faction*>(unit.faction()->link.resolve()));
2097 if (account == nullptr)
2098 return failure<resource::Receipt>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
2099 "RTS script faction economy was not found", "unit.faction");
2100 return account->debit(cost);
2101 });
2102 setPassiveIncomeCredit([accountForFaction](Building& building, const resource::CostSpec& cost)
2103 -> Result<resource::Receipt> {
2104 auto* account = accountForFaction(dynamic_cast<Faction*>(building.faction()->link.resolve()));
2105 if (account == nullptr)
2106 return failure<resource::Receipt>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
2107 "RTS script faction economy was not found", "building.faction");
2108 return account->credit(cost);
2109 });
2110 setMatchResourceQuery([this](Faction& faction, std::string_view resource) -> Result<double> {
2111 auto balance = scriptResource(faction, resource);
2112 if (!balance) return Result<double>::failure(balance.status());
2113 return Result<double>::success(static_cast<double>(balance.value()),
2114 Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
2115 });
2116 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
2117}

2203Result<void> RTS::addScriptResource(Faction& faction, std::string resource, std::int64_t amount) {

2206 if (!scriptRuntime_ || !scriptRuntime_->configured)
2207 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict, "RTS script world is not configured", "economy");
2208 const auto found = scriptRuntime_->economies.find(faction.identity()->subject.format());
2209 if (found == scriptRuntime_->economies.end())
2210 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound, "RTS script faction economy was not found", "faction");
2211 auto cost = resource::CostSpec::single(std::move(resource), amount);
2212 if (!cost) return Result<void>::failure(cost.status());
2213 auto credited = found->second->account.credit(std::move(cost).takeValue());
2214 if (!credited) return Result<void>::failure(credited.status());
2215 std::move(credited).takeValue();
2216 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
2217}

2232Result<void> RTS::configureScriptAI(Faction& faction, LogicalId workerDefinition,
2233 LogicalId armyDefinition, LogicalId targetBuildingDefinition, int desiredWorkers,
2234 int attackThreshold, float thinkInterval, float formationSpacing, bool enabled) {

2237 "RTS AI faction does not belong to this facade", "faction");
2238 if (!scriptRuntime_ || !scriptRuntime_->configured || definitions_ == nullptr)
2239 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
2240 "RTS AI requires a configured script world and content", "scriptRuntime");
2241 if (!workerDefinition.isValid() || !armyDefinition.isValid() ||
2242 !targetBuildingDefinition.isValid() || desiredWorkers < 0 || attackThreshold <= 0 ||
2243 !std::isfinite(thinkInterval) || thinkInterval <= 0.0f ||
2244 !std::isfinite(formationSpacing) || formationSpacing <= 0.0f ||
2245 !definitions_->resolve("unit", std::string(workerDefinition.name())) ||
2246 !definitions_->resolve("unit", std::string(armyDefinition.name())) ||
2247 !definitions_->resolve("building", std::string(targetBuildingDefinition.name())))
2248 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2249 "RTS AI policy requires known definitions and positive finite policy values", "strategy");
2250 auto strategy = faction.strategy();
2251 strategy->workerDefinition = std::move(workerDefinition);
2252 strategy->armyDefinition = std::move(armyDefinition);
2253 strategy->targetBuildingDefinition = std::move(targetBuildingDefinition);
2254 strategy->desiredWorkers = desiredWorkers;
2255 strategy->attackThreshold = attackThreshold;
2256 strategy->thinkInterval = thinkInterval;
2257 strategy->thinkAccumulator = 0.0f;
2258 strategy->formationSpacing = formationSpacing;
2259 strategy->enabled = enabled;
2260 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
2261}

2269Result<RTSBuildReceipt> RTS::queueScriptUnit(Building& producer, SubjectRef unitSubject,
2270 LogicalId unitDefinition, int priority) {
2271 if (!owns(buildings_, producer))
2272 return failure<RTSBuildReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
2273 "RTS producer does not belong to this facade", "producer");
2274 if (!scriptRuntime_ || !scriptRuntime_->configured || definitions_ == nullptr)
2275 return failure<RTSBuildReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
2276 "RTS script world and content must be configured", "scriptRuntime");
2277 if (!unitSubject.isValid() || ownsSubject(unitSubject))
2278 return failure<RTSBuildReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
2279 "RTS produced unit subject is invalid or already owned", "unitSubject");
2280 if (!unitDefinition.isValid())
2281 return failure<RTSBuildReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2282 "RTS production requires a unit definition", "unitDefinition");
2283 auto resolved = definitions_->resolve("unit", std::string(unitDefinition.name()));
2284 if (!resolved) return Result<RTSBuildReceipt>::failure(resolved.status());
2285 auto parsed = Value::fromJson(resolved.value().get().json);
2286 if (!parsed) return Result<RTSBuildReceipt>::failure(parsed.status());
2287 const auto* object = parsed.value().getIf<Value::Object>();
2288 if (object == nullptr)
2289 return failure<RTSBuildReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2290 "RTS unit definition must be an object", "unitDefinition");
2291 const auto resourceIt = object->find("costResource");
2292 const auto costIt = object->find("cost");
2293 const auto timeIt = object->find("buildTime");
2294 const auto producerIt = object->find("producer");
2295 if (resourceIt == object->end() || costIt == object->end() || timeIt == object->end())
2296 return failure<RTSBuildReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2297 "RTS unit definition lacks production cost or duration", "unitDefinition");
2298 const auto* resourceName = resourceIt->second.getIf<std::string>();
2299 const auto number = [](const Value& value) -> std::optional<double> {
2300 if (const auto* integer = value.getIf<std::int64_t>()) return static_cast<double>(*integer);
2301 if (const auto* real = value.getIf<double>()) return *real;
2302 return std::nullopt;
2303 };
2304 const auto costNumber = number(costIt->second);
2305 const auto timeNumber = number(timeIt->second);
2306 if (resourceName == nullptr || resourceName->empty() || !costNumber || !timeNumber ||
2307 !std::isfinite(*costNumber) || *costNumber < 0.0 || std::floor(*costNumber) != *costNumber ||
2308 !std::isfinite(*timeNumber) || *timeNumber <= 0.0)
2309 return failure<RTSBuildReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2310 "RTS unit production values are invalid", "unitDefinition");
2311 if (producerIt != object->end()) {
2312 const auto* requiredProducer = producerIt->second.getIf<std::string>();
2313 if (requiredProducer == nullptr || *requiredProducer != producer.definition()->id.name())
2314 return failure<RTSBuildReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
2315 "RTS building cannot produce this unit definition", "producer");
2316 }
2317 auto* faction = dynamic_cast<Faction*>(producer.faction()->link.resolve());
2318 if (faction == nullptr)
2319 return failure<RTSBuildReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
2320 "RTS producer faction link is stale", "producer.faction");
2321 const auto economy = scriptRuntime_->economies.find(faction->identity()->subject.format());
2322 if (economy == scriptRuntime_->economies.end())
2323 return failure<RTSBuildReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
2324 "RTS producer economy was not found", "producer.faction");
2325 auto cost = resource::CostSpec::single(*resourceName, static_cast<std::int64_t>(*costNumber));
2326 if (!cost) return Result<RTSBuildReceipt>::failure(cost.status());
2327 const resource::CostSpec paidCost = cost.value();
2328 auto duration = Duration::fromSeconds(*timeNumber);
2329 if (!duration) return Result<RTSBuildReceipt>::failure(duration.status());
2330 auto receipt = build(producer, scriptRuntime_->actions, economy->second->account,
2331 std::move(cost).takeValue(), std::string(unitDefinition.name()),
2332 std::move(duration).takeValue(), "unit", priority,
2333 "rts.script.production." + unitSubject.format());
2334 if (!receipt) return receipt;
2335 scriptRuntime_->pendingProductionSubjects.emplace(receipt.value().productionTaskId, unitSubject);
2336 scriptRuntime_->paidProduction.push_back({producer.identity()->subject, unitSubject, "unit",
2337 std::string(unitDefinition.name()), receipt.value().productionTaskId, receipt.value().orderId, paidCost});
2338 return receipt;
2339}
2340
2341Result<ReinforcementRequestReceipt> RTS::queueScriptReinforcement(
2342 Building& producer, SubjectRef unitSubject, LogicalId preferredDefinition, int priority) {
2343 if (!owns(buildings_, producer))
2344 return failure<ReinforcementRequestReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
2345 "RTS reinforcement producer does not belong to this facade", "producer");
2346 if (!unitSubject.isValid() || ownsSubject(unitSubject) || !preferredDefinition.isValid())
2347 return failure<ReinforcementRequestReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2348 "RTS reinforcement requires a new stable subject and preferred unit definition", "reinforcement");
2349 return ReinforcementProductionPolicySystem::request(producer, std::string(preferredDefinition.name()),
2350 [&](Building& selectedProducer, std::string_view candidate) -> Result<std::string> {
2351 auto definition = LogicalId::parse(candidate);
2352 if (!definition)
2353 definition = LogicalId::parse("unit:" + std::string(candidate));
2354 if (!definition)
2355 return failure<std::string>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2356 "RTS reinforcement fallback is not a valid unit definition", "reinforcement.fallback");
2357 auto queued = queueScriptUnit(selectedProducer, unitSubject, *definition, priority);
2358 if (!queued) return Result<std::string>::failure(queued.status());
2359 return Result<std::string>::success(queued.value().productionTaskId,
2360 Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
2361 });
2362}
2363
2364Result<Building*> RTS::startScriptConstruction(Faction& faction, SubjectRef buildingSubject,
2365 LogicalId buildingDefinition, WorldPosition position,
2366 Unit& builder) {
2367 if (!owns(factions_, faction) || !owns(units_, builder))
2368 return failure<Building*>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
2369 "RTS construction faction or builder does not belong to this facade",
2370 "construction");
2371 if (builder.faction()->link.resolve() != &faction || builder.worker()->buildRate <= 0.0f)
2372 return failure<Building*>(DiagnosticCode::PreconditionViolation,
2373 "RTS construction requires a same-faction builder", "builder");
2374 if (!scriptRuntime_ || !scriptRuntime_->configured || definitions_ == nullptr ||
2375 !buildingSubject.isValid() || ownsSubject(buildingSubject) || !buildingDefinition.isValid() ||
2376 !std::isfinite(position.x) || !std::isfinite(position.y))
2377 return failure<Building*>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2378 "RTS construction request is invalid or the world is not configured",
2379 "construction");
2380 auto resolved = definitions_->resolve("building", std::string(buildingDefinition.name()));
2381 if (!resolved) return Result<Building*>::failure(resolved.status());
2382 auto parsed = Value::fromJson(resolved.value().get().json);
2383 if (!parsed) return Result<Building*>::failure(parsed.status());
2384 const auto* object = parsed.value().getIf<Value::Object>();
2385 if (object == nullptr)
2386 return failure<Building*>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2387 "RTS building definition must be an object", "buildingDefinition");
2388 const auto resourceIt = object->find("costResource");
2389 const auto costIt = object->find("cost");
2390 if (resourceIt == object->end() || costIt == object->end())
2391 return failure<Building*>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2392 "RTS building definition lacks a construction cost", "buildingDefinition");
2393 const auto* resourceName = resourceIt->second.getIf<std::string>();
2394 double costNumber = -1.0;
2395 if (const auto* integer = costIt->second.getIf<std::int64_t>()) costNumber = static_cast<double>(*integer);
2396 else if (const auto* real = costIt->second.getIf<double>()) costNumber = *real;
2397 if (resourceName == nullptr || resourceName->empty() || !std::isfinite(costNumber) || costNumber < 0.0 ||
2398 std::floor(costNumber) != costNumber)
2399 return failure<Building*>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2400 "RTS building construction cost is invalid", "buildingDefinition");
2401 const auto economy = scriptRuntime_->economies.find(faction.identity()->subject.format());
2402 if (economy == scriptRuntime_->economies.end())
2403 return failure<Building*>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
2404 "RTS construction economy was not found", "faction");
2405 auto cost = resource::CostSpec::single(*resourceName, static_cast<std::int64_t>(costNumber));
2406 if (!cost) return Result<Building*>::failure(cost.status());
2407 auto previousOrders = builder.orders()->values.snapshotState();
2408 if (!previousOrders) return Result<Building*>::failure(previousOrders.status());
2409 auto paid = economy->second->account.debit(cost.value());
2410 if (!paid) return Result<Building*>::failure(paid.status());
2411
2412 const std::size_t weaponCount = weapons_.size();
2413 auto created = newFactionBuilding(faction, buildingSubject, buildingDefinition);
2414 if (!created) {
2415 economy->second->account.credit(cost.value()).ignore("compensate failed construction root creation");
2416 return created;
2417 }
2418 Building* building = created.value();
2419 building->placement()->worldX = position.x;
2420 building->placement()->worldY = position.y;
2421 building->construction()->progress = 0.0f;
2422 building->construction()->builders = {ecs::handle_of(&builder)};
2423 CommandSpec move;
2424 move.kind = OrderKind::Move;
2425 move.target = position;
2426 auto ordered = builder.orders()->values.replace(move);
2427 if (ordered) {
2428 CommandSpec buildCommand;
2429 buildCommand.kind = OrderKind::Build;
2430 buildCommand.target = position;
2431 buildCommand.targetEntity = ecs::handle_of(building);
2432 ordered = builder.orders()->values.enqueue(buildCommand);
2433 }
2434 if (!ordered) {
2435 const Status status = ordered.status();
2436 builder.orders()->values.restoreState(previousOrders.value()).ignore("restore construction builder orders");
2437 faction.members()->buildings.pop_back();
2438 building->release();
2439 buildings_.pop_back();
2440 while (weapons_.size() > weaponCount) {
2441 if (auto* weapon = dynamic_cast<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(ecs::try_get(weapons_.back()))) weapon->release();
2442 weapons_.pop_back();
2443 }
2444 economy->second->account.credit(cost.value()).ignore("compensate failed construction order");
2445 return Result<Building*>::failure(status);
2446 }
2447 std::move(ordered).takeValue();
2448 scriptRuntime_->paidConstruction.push_back(
2449 {buildingSubject, faction.identity()->subject, cost.value()});
2450 return Result<Building*>::success(building, Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
2451}
2452
2453Result<resource::Receipt> RTS::cancelScriptConstruction(Building& building) {
2454 if (!owns(buildings_, building))
2455 return failure<resource::Receipt>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
2456 "RTS construction does not belong to this facade", "building");
2457 if (!scriptRuntime_ || !scriptRuntime_->configured || !building.integrity()->alive ||
2458 building.construction()->progress >= 1.0f)
2459 return failure<resource::Receipt>(DiagnosticCode::PreconditionViolation,
2460 "RTS construction cancellation requires a live unfinished script building", "building.construction");
2461 const auto payment = std::find_if(scriptRuntime_->paidConstruction.begin(),
2462 scriptRuntime_->paidConstruction.end(), [&](const auto& value) {
2463 return value.building == building.identity()->subject;
2464 });
2465 if (payment == scriptRuntime_->paidConstruction.end())
2466 return failure<resource::Receipt>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
2467 "RTS construction payment record was not found", "building.construction");
2468 auto* faction = findFaction(payment->faction);
2469 if (faction == nullptr)
2470 return failure<resource::Receipt>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
2471 "RTS construction faction is stale", "building.faction");
2472 const auto economy = scriptRuntime_->economies.find(payment->faction.format());
2473 if (economy == scriptRuntime_->economies.end())
2474 return failure<resource::Receipt>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
2475 "RTS construction economy was not found", "building.faction");
2476 auto refund = scaledCost(payment->cost,
2477 1.0 - 0.5 * std::clamp(static_cast<double>(building.construction()->progress), 0.0, 1.0));
2478 if (!refund) return Result<resource::Receipt>::failure(refund.status());
2479 auto credited = economy->second->account.credit(refund.value());
2480 if (!credited) return Result<resource::Receipt>::failure(credited.status());
2481
2482 for (const auto& builderHandle : building.construction()->builders) {
2483 auto* builder = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(builderHandle));
2484 if (builder != nullptr) builder->orders()->values.clear();
2485 }
2486 building.construction()->builders.clear();
2487 building.integrity()->alive = false;
2488 building.integrity()->state.health = 0.0;
2489 building.placement()->placed = false;
2490 const auto buildingHandle = ecs::handle_of(&building);
2491 std::erase_if(faction->members()->buildings,
2492 [&](const auto& value) { return sameHandle(value, buildingHandle); });
2493 const auto weaponHandle = building.weapon()->link.handle();
2494 if (auto* weapon = dynamic_cast<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(building.weapon()->link.resolve())) weapon->release();
2495 std::erase_if(weapons_, [&](const auto& value) { return sameHandle(value, weaponHandle); });
2496 std::erase_if(buildings_, [&](const auto& value) { return sameHandle(value, buildingHandle); });
2497 scriptRuntime_->paidConstruction.erase(payment);
2498 building.release();
2499 return credited;
2500}
2501
2502Result<resource::Receipt> RTS::sellScriptBuilding(Building& building) {
2503 if (!owns(buildings_, building))
2504 return failure<resource::Receipt>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
2505 "RTS building does not belong to this facade", "building");
2506 if (!scriptRuntime_ || !scriptRuntime_->configured || definitions_ == nullptr ||
2507 !building.integrity()->alive || building.construction()->progress < 1.0f)
2508 return failure<resource::Receipt>(DiagnosticCode::PreconditionViolation,
2509 "RTS sale requires a live completed script building", "building.construction");
2510 auto* faction = dynamic_cast<Faction*>(building.faction()->link.resolve());
2511 if (faction == nullptr)
2512 return failure<resource::Receipt>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
2513 "RTS building faction link is stale", "building.faction");
2514 const auto economy = scriptRuntime_->economies.find(faction->identity()->subject.format());
2515 if (economy == scriptRuntime_->economies.end())
2516 return failure<resource::Receipt>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
2517 "RTS building economy was not found", "building.faction");
2518 auto definition = definitions_->resolve("building", std::string(building.definition()->id.name()));
2519 if (!definition) return Result<resource::Receipt>::failure(definition.status());
2520 auto parsed = Value::fromJson(definition.value().get().json);
2521 if (!parsed) return Result<resource::Receipt>::failure(parsed.status());
2522 const auto* object = parsed.value().getIf<Value::Object>();
2523 if (object == nullptr)
2524 return failure<resource::Receipt>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2525 "RTS building definition must be an object", "building.definition");
2526 const auto resourceIt = object->find("costResource");
2527 const auto costIt = object->find("cost");
2528 if (resourceIt == object->end() || costIt == object->end() ||
2529 resourceIt->second.getIf<std::string>() == nullptr)
2530 return failure<resource::Receipt>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2531 "RTS building definition lacks a sale cost", "building.definition");
2532 double costNumber = -1.0;
2533 if (const auto* integer = costIt->second.getIf<std::int64_t>())
2534 costNumber = static_cast<double>(*integer);
2535 else if (const auto* real = costIt->second.getIf<double>()) costNumber = *real;
2536 double ratio = 0.5;
2537 if (const auto ratioIt = object->find("sellRefundRatio"); ratioIt != object->end()) {
2538 if (const auto* integer = ratioIt->second.getIf<std::int64_t>())
2539 ratio = static_cast<double>(*integer);
2540 else if (const auto* real = ratioIt->second.getIf<double>()) ratio = *real;
2541 else ratio = -1.0;
2542 }
2543 if (!std::isfinite(costNumber) || costNumber <= 0.0 || std::floor(costNumber) != costNumber ||
2544 !std::isfinite(ratio) || ratio <= 0.0 || ratio > 1.0)
2545 return failure<resource::Receipt>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2546 "RTS building sale values are invalid", "building.definition");
2547 auto baseCost = resource::CostSpec::single(*resourceIt->second.getIf<std::string>(),
2548 static_cast<std::int64_t>(costNumber));
2549 if (!baseCost) return Result<resource::Receipt>::failure(baseCost.status());
2550 auto saleRefund = scaledCost(baseCost.value(), ratio);
2551 if (!saleRefund) return Result<resource::Receipt>::failure(saleRefund.status());
2552
2553 auto rootBefore = snapshotState();
2554 if (!rootBefore) return Result<resource::Receipt>::failure(rootBefore.status());
2555 const auto ledgerBefore = economy->second->ledger.snapshot();
2556 const auto pendingBefore = scriptRuntime_->pendingProductionSubjects;
2557 const auto paymentsBefore = scriptRuntime_->paidProduction;
2558 const SubjectRef producerSubject = building.identity()->subject;
2559 const auto rollback = [&]() {
2560 economy->second->ledger.restore(ledgerBefore);
2561 scriptRuntime_->pendingProductionSubjects = pendingBefore;
2562 scriptRuntime_->paidProduction = paymentsBefore;
2563 (void)restoreState(rootBefore.value());
2564 };
2565 for (const auto& record : paymentsBefore) {
2566 if (record.producer != producerSubject) continue;
2567 auto task = building.production()->values.find(record.taskId);
2568 if (!task || task->get().state == production::TaskState::Completed ||
2569 task->get().state == production::TaskState::Cancelled ||
2570 task->get().state == production::TaskState::Failed) continue;
2571 auto cancelled = cancelProduction(building, economy->second->account, record.taskId,
2572 record.orderId, record.refund, "building sold");
2573 if (!cancelled) {
2574 rollback();
2575 return Result<resource::Receipt>::failure(cancelled.status());
2576 }
2577 scriptRuntime_->pendingProductionSubjects.erase(record.taskId);
2578 std::erase_if(scriptRuntime_->paidProduction,
2579 [&](const auto& value) { return value.taskId == record.taskId; });
2580 }
2581 auto credited = economy->second->account.credit(saleRefund.value());
2582 if (!credited) {
2583 rollback();
2584 return Result<resource::Receipt>::failure(credited.status());
2585 }
2586 auto evacuated = evacuateBuilding(building,
2587 {building.placement()->worldX + 2.0f, building.placement()->worldY});
2588 if (!evacuated) {
2589 rollback();
2590 return Result<resource::Receipt>::failure(evacuated.status());
2591 }
2592
2593 const auto buildingHandle = ecs::handle_of(&building);
2594 for (const auto& factionHandle : factions_) {
2595 auto* owner = dynamic_cast<Faction*>(ecs::try_get(factionHandle));
2596 if (owner != nullptr)
2597 std::erase_if(owner->members()->buildings,
2598 [&](const auto& value) { return sameHandle(value, buildingHandle); });
2599 }
2600 const auto weaponHandle = building.weapon()->link.handle();
2601 if (auto* weapon = dynamic_cast<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(building.weapon()->link.resolve())) weapon->release();
2602 std::erase_if(weapons_, [&](const auto& value) { return sameHandle(value, weaponHandle); });
2603 std::erase_if(buildings_, [&](const auto& value) { return sameHandle(value, buildingHandle); });
2604 std::erase_if(scriptRuntime_->paidConstruction,
2605 [&](const auto& value) { return value.building == producerSubject; });
2606 building.release();
2607 return credited;
2608}

2610Result<RTSBuildReceipt> RTS::queueScriptResearch(Building& producer, std::string upgrade, int priority) {
2611 if (!owns(buildings_, producer))
2612 return failure<RTSBuildReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
2613 "RTS research producer does not belong to this facade", "producer");
2614 if (!scriptRuntime_ || !scriptRuntime_->configured || definitions_ == nullptr || upgrade.empty())
2615 return failure<RTSBuildReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2616 "RTS research requires a configured world and upgrade", "upgrade");
2617 auto* faction = dynamic_cast<Faction*>(producer.faction()->link.resolve());
2618 if (faction == nullptr)
2619 return failure<RTSBuildReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
2620 "RTS research producer faction link is stale", "producer.faction");
2621 if (std::binary_search(faction->technology()->unlocked.begin(), faction->technology()->unlocked.end(), upgrade))
2622 return failure<RTSBuildReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
2623 "RTS upgrade is already unlocked", "upgrade");
2624 for (int index = 0; index < static_cast<int>(producer.production()->values.taskCount()); ++index) {
2625 auto task = producer.production()->values.taskAt(index);
2626 if (task && task->get().kind == "research" && task->get().product == upgrade &&
2627 task->get().state != production::TaskState::Cancelled &&
2628 task->get().state != production::TaskState::Failed)
2629 return failure<RTSBuildReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
2630 "RTS upgrade is already queued", "upgrade");
2631 }
2632 auto resolved = definitions_->resolve("upgrade", upgrade);
2633 if (!resolved) return Result<RTSBuildReceipt>::failure(resolved.status());
2634 auto parsed = Value::fromJson(resolved.value().get().json);
2635 if (!parsed) return Result<RTSBuildReceipt>::failure(parsed.status());
2636 const auto* object = parsed.value().getIf<Value::Object>();
2637 if (object == nullptr)
2638 return failure<RTSBuildReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2639 "RTS upgrade definition must be an object", "upgrade");
2640 const auto textField = [object](std::string_view name) -> std::string {
2641 const auto found = object->find(std::string(name));
2642 if (found == object->end()) return {};
2643 const auto* value = found->second.getIf<std::string>();
2644 return value == nullptr ? std::string{} : *value;
2645 };
2646 const auto numberField = [object](std::string_view name) -> std::optional<double> {
2647 const auto found = object->find(std::string(name));
2648 if (found == object->end()) return std::nullopt;
2649 if (const auto* integer = found->second.getIf<std::int64_t>()) return static_cast<double>(*integer);
2650 if (const auto* real = found->second.getIf<double>()) return *real;
2651 return std::nullopt;
2652 };
2653 const std::string requiredProducer = textField("producer");
2654 const std::string prerequisite = textField("prerequisiteUpgrade");
2655 const std::string resourceName = textField("costResource");
2656 const auto costNumber = numberField("cost");
2657 const auto researchTime = numberField("researchTime");
2658 if (requiredProducer != producer.definition()->id.name())
2659 return failure<RTSBuildReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
2660 "RTS building cannot research this upgrade", "producer");
2661 if (!prerequisite.empty() &&
2662 !std::binary_search(faction->technology()->unlocked.begin(), faction->technology()->unlocked.end(),
2663 prerequisite))
2664 return failure<RTSBuildReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::PreconditionViolation,
2665 "RTS research prerequisite is not unlocked", "upgrade");
2666 if (resourceName.empty() || !costNumber || !researchTime || !std::isfinite(*costNumber) ||
2667 *costNumber < 0.0 || std::floor(*costNumber) != *costNumber || !std::isfinite(*researchTime) ||
2668 *researchTime <= 0.0)
2669 return failure<RTSBuildReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2670 "RTS upgrade cost or research duration is invalid", "upgrade");
2671 const auto economy = scriptRuntime_->economies.find(faction->identity()->subject.format());
2672 if (economy == scriptRuntime_->economies.end())
2673 return failure<RTSBuildReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
2674 "RTS research economy was not found", "producer.faction");
2675 auto cost = resource::CostSpec::single(resourceName, static_cast<std::int64_t>(*costNumber));
2676 auto duration = Duration::fromSeconds(*researchTime);
2677 if (!cost) return Result<RTSBuildReceipt>::failure(cost.status());
2678 if (!duration) return Result<RTSBuildReceipt>::failure(duration.status());
2679 const resource::CostSpec paidCost = cost.value();
2680 const std::string product = upgrade;
2681 auto receipt = build(producer, scriptRuntime_->actions, economy->second->account, std::move(cost).takeValue(),
2682 std::move(upgrade), std::move(duration).takeValue(), "research", priority);
2683 if (receipt) scriptRuntime_->paidProduction.push_back({producer.identity()->subject, {}, "research", product,
2684 receipt.value().productionTaskId, receipt.value().orderId, paidCost});
2685 return receipt;
2686}

2688Result<RTSCancelProductionReceipt> RTS::cancelScriptProduction(Building& producer, int queueIndex) {
2689 if (!owns(buildings_, producer))
2690 return failure<RTSCancelProductionReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
2691 "RTS producer does not belong to this facade", "producer");
2692 if (!scriptRuntime_ || !scriptRuntime_->configured || queueIndex < -1)
2693 return failure<RTSCancelProductionReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2694 "RTS production cancellation requires a configured world and valid queue index", "queueIndex");
2695 std::vector<std::string> active;
2696 for (int index = 0; index < static_cast<int>(producer.production()->values.taskCount()); ++index) {
2697 auto task = producer.production()->values.taskAt(index);
2698 if (task && task->get().state != production::TaskState::Completed &&
2699 task->get().state != production::TaskState::Cancelled &&
2700 task->get().state != production::TaskState::Failed)
2701 active.push_back(task->get().id);
2702 }
2703 if (active.empty())
2704 return failure<RTSCancelProductionReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
2705 "RTS producer has no cancellable production", "production");
2706 if (queueIndex < 0) queueIndex = static_cast<int>(active.size()) - 1;
2707 if (queueIndex >= static_cast<int>(active.size()))
2708 return failure<RTSCancelProductionReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
2709 "RTS production queue index was not found", "queueIndex");
2710 const auto record = std::find_if(scriptRuntime_->paidProduction.begin(), scriptRuntime_->paidProduction.end(),
2711 [&](const auto& value) { return value.taskId == active[static_cast<std::size_t>(queueIndex)] &&
2712 value.producer == producer.identity()->subject; });
2713 if (record == scriptRuntime_->paidProduction.end())
2714 return failure<RTSCancelProductionReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
2715 "RTS production payment record was not found", "production.task");
2716 auto* faction = dynamic_cast<Faction*>(producer.faction()->link.resolve());
2717 if (faction == nullptr)
2718 return failure<RTSCancelProductionReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
2719 "RTS producer faction link is stale", "producer.faction");
2720 const auto economy = scriptRuntime_->economies.find(faction->identity()->subject.format());
2721 if (economy == scriptRuntime_->economies.end())
2722 return failure<RTSCancelProductionReceipt>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
2723 "RTS producer economy was not found", "producer.faction");
2724 const std::string taskId = record->taskId;
2725 auto cancelled = cancelProduction(producer, economy->second->account, record->taskId, record->orderId,
2726 record->refund, "script production cancelled");
2727 if (!cancelled) return cancelled;
2728 scriptRuntime_->pendingProductionSubjects.erase(taskId);
2729 scriptRuntime_->paidProduction.erase(record);
2730 return cancelled;
2731}

2733Result<void> RTS::setBuildingRally(
2734 Building& producer, CommandSpec command, bool groupedReinforcements) const {
2735 if (!owns(buildings_, producer))
2736 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
2737 "RTS rally producer does not belong to this facade", "producer");
2738 auto valid = command.validate();
2739 if (!valid) return valid;
2740 if (command.kind != OrderKind::Move && command.kind != OrderKind::AttackMove)
2741 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2742 "RTS rally command must be Move or AttackMove", "command.kind");
2743 auto& rally = *producer.rally();
2744 rally = {};
2745 rally.enabled = true;
2746 rally.command = std::move(command);
2747 rally.combatGroup = groupedReinforcements
2748 ? stableRallyGroup(producer.identity()->subject) : 0;
2749 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
2750}

2752Result<void> RTS::linkBuildingRally(Building& producer, Building& source) const {
2753 if (!owns(buildings_, producer) || !owns(buildings_, source) || &producer == &source)
2754 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
2755 "RTS rally link requires two distinct owned producers", "producer");
2756 if (producer.faction()->link.resolve() != source.faction()->link.resolve() ||
2757 !source.rally()->enabled || source.rally()->combatGroup == 0)
2758 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::PreconditionViolation,
2759 "RTS rally source must be a grouped friendly rally", "source.rally");
2760 auto linked = *source.rally();
2761 linked.transport = {};
2762 linked.minimumTransportLoad = 1;
2763 linked.transportActive = false;
2764 linked.productionSpawnBlocked = false;
2765 linked.blockedProductionTask.clear();
2766 linked.settledProductionTasks.clear();
2767 linked.reinforcements.clear();
2768 linked.reinforcementCapped = false;
2769 linked.reinforcementPolicyPausedTask.clear();
2770 linked.reinforcementCappedSeconds = 0.0f;
2771 *producer.rally() = std::move(linked);
2772 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
2773}

2783Result<void> RTS::setReinforcementLimit(Building& producer, std::size_t maximum) const {
2784 if (!owns(buildings_, producer) || !producer.rally()->enabled || producer.rally()->combatGroup == 0)
2785 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::PreconditionViolation,
2786 "RTS reinforcement limit requires an owned grouped rally", "producer.rally");
2787 const auto group = producer.rally()->combatGroup;
2788 auto* faction = producer.faction()->link.resolve();
2789 for (const auto& handle : buildings_) {
2790 auto* building = dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(handle));
2791 if (building == nullptr || building->faction()->link.resolve() != faction ||
2792 building->rally()->combatGroup != group) continue;
2793 building->rally()->reinforcementLimit = maximum;
2794 building->rally()->reinforcementCapped = false;
2795 building->rally()->reinforcementCappedSeconds = 0.0f;
2796 }
2797 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
2798}

2800Result<void> RTS::setReinforcementTypeLimit(
2801 Building& producer, std::string unitType, std::size_t maximum) const {
2802 if (!owns(buildings_, producer) || !producer.rally()->enabled || producer.rally()->combatGroup == 0 ||
2803 unitType.empty() || definitions_ == nullptr || !definitions_->resolve("unit", unitType))
2804 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2805 "RTS reinforcement type limit requires a grouped rally and known unit type", "unitType");
2806 const auto group = producer.rally()->combatGroup;

2808 for (const auto& handle : buildings_) {

2810 if (building == nullptr || building->faction()->link.resolve() != faction ||
2811 building->rally()->combatGroup != group) continue;
2812 if (maximum == 0) building->rally()->reinforcementTypeLimits.erase(unitType);
2813 else building->rally()->reinforcementTypeLimits[unitType] = maximum;
2814 building->rally()->reinforcementCapped = false;
2815 building->rally()->reinforcementCappedSeconds = 0.0f;
2816 }
2817 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
2818}

2820Result<void> RTS::setReinforcementTypePriority(

2823 unitType.empty() || priority < 0 || definitions_ == nullptr || !definitions_->resolve("unit", unitType))
2824 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,

2826 "priority");

2839Result<void> RTS::setReinforcementFallback(
2840 Building& producer, std::string preferred, std::string fallback) const {
2841 if (!owns(buildings_, producer) || !producer.rally()->enabled || producer.rally()->combatGroup == 0 ||
2842 preferred.empty() || preferred == fallback || definitions_ == nullptr ||
2843 !definitions_->resolve("unit", preferred) || (!fallback.empty() && !definitions_->resolve("unit", fallback)))
2844 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2845 "RTS reinforcement fallback requires a grouped rally and known distinct unit types", "fallback");
2846 auto strategy = producer.rally()->reinforcementFallbacks;
2847 if (fallback.empty()) strategy.erase(preferred);
2848 else strategy[preferred] = fallback;
2849 for (const auto& [start, ignored] : strategy) {
2850 (void)ignored;
2851 std::set<std::string> visited;
2852 std::string current = start;
2853 while (true) {
2854 const auto next = strategy.find(current);
2855 if (next == strategy.end()) break;
2856 if (!visited.insert(current).second)
2857 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
2858 "RTS reinforcement fallback chain contains a cycle", "fallback");
2859 current = next->second;
2860 }
2861 }
2862 const auto group = producer.rally()->combatGroup;
2863 auto* faction = producer.faction()->link.resolve();
2864 for (const auto& handle : buildings_) {
2865 auto* building = dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(handle));
2866 if (building != nullptr && building->faction()->link.resolve() == faction &&
2867 building->rally()->combatGroup == group)
2868 building->rally()->reinforcementFallbacks = strategy;
2869 }
2870 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
2871}

2875 !std::isfinite(seconds) || seconds < 0.0f)
2876 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2877 "RTS reinforcement auto-cancel requires a grouped rally and non-negative delay", "seconds");
2878 const auto group = producer.rally()->combatGroup;
2879 auto* faction = producer.faction()->link.resolve();
2880 for (const auto& handle : buildings_) {
2881 auto* building = dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(handle));

2883 building->rally()->combatGroup != group) continue;
2884 building->rally()->reinforcementAutoCancelDelay = seconds;
2885 building->rally()->reinforcementCappedSeconds = 0.0f;
2886 }
2887 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));

2890Result<void> RTS::setReinforcementTransport(
2891 Building& producer, Unit* transport, std::size_t minimumLoad) const {
2892 if (!owns(buildings_, producer))
2893 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
2894 "RTS rally producer does not belong to this facade", "producer");
2895 if (transport == nullptr) {
2896 if (minimumLoad != 0)
2897 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2898 "RTS clearing a reinforcement transport requires zero minimum load", "minimumLoad");
2899 producer.rally()->transport = {};
2900 producer.rally()->minimumTransportLoad = 1;
2901 producer.rally()->transportActive = false;
2902 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
2903 }
2904 if (!owns(units_, *transport) || transport->faction()->link.resolve() != producer.faction()->link.resolve() ||
2905 transport->containment()->capacity == 0 || minimumLoad == 0 ||
2906 minimumLoad > transport->containment()->capacity || transport->containment()->container.isBound())
2907 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::PreconditionViolation,
2908 "RTS reinforcement transport must be an uncontained friendly carrier with a valid minimum load",
2909 "transport");
2910 const auto handle = ecs::handle_of(transport);
2911 for (const auto& buildingHandle : buildings_) {
2912 auto* building = dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(buildingHandle));
2913 const auto assigned = building == nullptr ? ecs::EntityHandle{} : building->rally()->transport;
2914 const bool sameTransport = assigned.table == handle.table && assigned.type == handle.type &&
2915 assigned.id == handle.id && assigned.generation == handle.generation;
2916 if (building != nullptr && building != &producer && sameTransport)
2917 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
2918 "RTS reinforcement transport is already assigned to another producer", "transport");
2919 }
2920 producer.rally()->transport = handle;
2921 producer.rally()->minimumTransportLoad = minimumLoad;
2922 producer.rally()->transportActive = false;
2923 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
2924}

2926Result<void> RTS::castScriptAbility(Unit& caster, std::string ability, SubjectRef target,
2927 WorldPosition point) {
2928 if (!owns(units_, caster))
2929 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
2930 "RTS ability caster does not belong to this facade", "caster");
2931 if (!scriptRuntime_ || !scriptRuntime_->configured || definitions_ == nullptr || ability.empty())
2932 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2933 "RTS ability requires configured script content", "ability");
2934 auto resolved = definitions_->resolve("ability", ability);
2935 if (!resolved) return Result<void>::failure(resolved.status());
2936 auto parsed = Value::fromJson(resolved.value().get().json);
2937 if (!parsed) return Result<void>::failure(parsed.status());
2938 const auto* object = parsed.value().getIf<Value::Object>();
2939 if (object == nullptr)
2940 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2941 "RTS ability definition must be an object", "ability");
2942 const auto textField = [object](std::string_view name, std::string fallback = {}) {
2943 const auto found = object->find(std::string(name));
2944 if (found == object->end()) return fallback;
2945 const auto* value = found->second.getIf<std::string>();
2946 return value == nullptr ? fallback : *value;
2947 };
2948 const auto numberField = [object](std::string_view name, double fallback) {
2949 const auto found = object->find(std::string(name));
2950 if (found == object->end()) return std::optional<double>{fallback};
2951 if (const auto* integer = found->second.getIf<std::int64_t>())
2952 return std::optional<double>{static_cast<double>(*integer)};
2953 if (const auto* real = found->second.getIf<double>()) return std::optional<double>{*real};
2954 return std::optional<double>{};
2955 };
2956 const auto boolField = [object](std::string_view name, bool fallback) {
2957 const auto found = object->find(std::string(name));
2958 if (found == object->end()) return std::optional<bool>{fallback};
2959 const auto* value = found->second.getIf<bool>();
2960 return value == nullptr ? std::optional<bool>{} : std::optional<bool>{*value};
2961 };
2962 AbilitySpec spec;
2963 spec.id = ability;
2964 const std::string casterDefinition = textField("casterUnit");
2965 if (!casterDefinition.empty()) {
2966 const auto id = LogicalId::fromParts("unit", casterDefinition);
2967 if (!id) return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2968 "RTS ability caster definition is invalid", "casterUnit");
2969 spec.casterDefinition = *id;
2970 }
2971 const std::string targetType = textField("targetType", "enemy");
2972 if (targetType == "self") spec.target = AbilityTarget::Self;
2973 else if (targetType == "ally") spec.target = AbilityTarget::Ally;
2974 else if (targetType == "enemy") spec.target = AbilityTarget::Enemy;
2975 else if (targetType == "point") spec.target = AbilityTarget::Point;
2976 else return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS ability target type is invalid", "targetType");
2977 const auto range = numberField("range", 0.0);
2978 const auto radius = numberField("radius", 0.0);
2979 const auto cooldown = numberField("cooldown", 0.0);
2980 const auto damage = numberField("damage", 0.0);
2981 const auto healing = numberField("healing", 0.0);
2982 const auto castTime = numberField("castTime", 0.0);
2983 const auto tickInterval = numberField("tickInterval", 0.0);
2984 const auto resourceCost = numberField("resourceCost", 0.0);
2985 const auto interrupt = boolField("interruptOnDamage", true);
2986 if (!range || !radius || !cooldown || !damage || !healing || !castTime || !tickInterval ||
2987 !resourceCost || !interrupt || std::floor(*resourceCost) != *resourceCost)
2988 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
2989 "RTS ability definition contains an invalid field", "ability");
2990 spec.range = static_cast<float>(*range);
2991 spec.radius = static_cast<float>(*radius);
2992 spec.cooldown = static_cast<float>(*cooldown);
2993 spec.damage = static_cast<float>(*damage);
2994 spec.healing = static_cast<float>(*healing);
2995 spec.castTime = static_cast<float>(*castTime);
2996 spec.channelTickInterval = static_cast<float>(*tickInterval);
2997 spec.resourceCost = static_cast<std::int64_t>(*resourceCost);
2998 spec.resourceType = textField("resourceType");
2999 spec.damageType = textField("damageType", "normal");
3000 spec.interruptOnDamage = *interrupt;
3001 const std::string statusEffect = textField("statusEffect");
3002 if (!statusEffect.empty()) {
3003 auto effectDefinition = resolveEffectDefinition(
3004 *definitions_, statusEffect, caster.identity()->subject);
3005 if (!effectDefinition) return Result<void>::failure(effectDefinition.status());
3006 spec.appliesEffect = true;
3007 spec.effect = std::move(effectDefinition).takeValue();
3008 }
3009 ecs::EntityHandle targetHandle{};
3010 if (target.isValid()) {
3011 ecs::Entity* entity = findUnit(target);
3012 if (entity == nullptr) entity = findBuilding(target);
3013 if (entity == nullptr)
3014 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound, "RTS ability target was not found", "target");
3015 targetHandle = ecs::handle_of(entity);
3016 }
3017 const AbilityResourceDebit debit = [this](Unit& unit, const resource::CostSpec& cost)
3018 -> Result<resource::Receipt> {
3019 auto* faction = dynamic_cast<Faction*>(unit.faction()->link.resolve());
3020 if (faction == nullptr || !scriptRuntime_)
3021 return failure<resource::Receipt>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
3022 "RTS ability caster faction is stale", "caster.faction");
3023 const auto economy = scriptRuntime_->economies.find(faction->identity()->subject.format());
3024 if (economy == scriptRuntime_->economies.end())
3025 return failure<resource::Receipt>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
3026 "RTS ability economy was not found", "caster.faction");
3027 return economy->second->account.debit(cost);
3028 };
3029 const DamageEventSink damageEvents = [this](const combat::DamageRequest& request,
3030 const combat::DamageOutcome& outcome,
3031 SimulationTick tick, DamageChannel channel) {
3032 recordDamageEvent(request, outcome, tick, channel);
3033 };
3034 const LifecycleEventSink lifecycleEvents = [this](const LifecycleEvent& event, SimulationTick tick) {
3035 recordLifecycleEvent(event, tick);
3036 };
3037 return AbilitySystem::cast(caster, spec, targetHandle, point, scriptRuntime_->damage, debit,
3038 damageEvents, SimulationTick(scriptTick()), lifecycleEvents);
3039}

3041Result<void> RTS::cancelScriptAbility(Unit& caster) {
3042 if (!owns(units_, caster))
3043 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::StaleHandle,
3044 "RTS ability caster does not belong to this facade", "caster");
3045 if (!caster.abilities()->channel)
3046 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound, "RTS unit has no active ability channel", "ability.channel");
3047 const auto channel = *caster.abilities()->channel;
3048 SubjectRef cancelledTarget;
3049 if (auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(channel.target)))
3050 cancelledTarget = unit->identity()->subject;
3051 else if (auto* building = dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(channel.target)))
3052 cancelledTarget = building->identity()->subject;
3053 caster.abilities()->channel.reset();
3054 recordLifecycleEvent({LifecycleEventKind::AbilityChannelCancelled, caster.identity()->subject,
3055 cancelledTarget, channel.spec.id,
3056 channel.remaining}, SimulationTick(scriptTick()));
3057 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
3058}
