3126Result<void> RTS::captureScriptCheckpoint(std::string name) {
3127 if (!scriptRuntime_ || !scriptRuntime_->configured)
3128 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
3129 "RTS script world must be configured before capturing a checkpoint", "scriptWorld");
3130 if (name.empty())
3131 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS checkpoint name must not be empty", "name");
3132 auto roots = snapshotState();
3133 if (!roots) return Result<void>::failure(roots.status());
3134
3135 ScriptRuntime::Checkpoint checkpoint;
3136 checkpoint.roots = std::move(roots).takeValue();
3137 checkpoint.pendingProductionSubjects = scriptRuntime_->pendingProductionSubjects;
3138 checkpoint.paidProduction = scriptRuntime_->paidProduction;
3139 checkpoint.paidConstruction = scriptRuntime_->paidConstruction;
3140 checkpoint.commandLog = scriptRuntime_->commandLog;
3141 checkpoint.nextTick = scriptRuntime_->nextTick;
3142 checkpoint.aiProductionSequence = scriptRuntime_->aiProductionSequence;
3143 for (const auto& [key, slot] : scriptRuntime_->economies)
3144 checkpoint.economies.emplace(key, slot->ledger.snapshot());
3145 for (const auto& [key, fov] : scriptRuntime_->fovs)
3146 if (fov) checkpoint.fovs.emplace(key, fov->snapshot());
3147 checkpoint.navigationCosts.reserve(static_cast<std::size_t>(scriptRuntime_->width * scriptRuntime_->height));
3148 for (int y = 0; y < scriptRuntime_->height; ++y)
3149 for (int x = 0; x < scriptRuntime_->width; ++x)
3150 checkpoint.navigationCosts.push_back(scriptRuntime_->pathfinder.getCellCost(x, y));
3151 checkpoint.terrainElevations = scriptRuntime_->terrainElevations;
3152 scriptRuntime_->checkpoints.insert_or_assign(std::move(name), std::move(checkpoint));
3153 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
3154}
3155
3156Result<void> RTS::restoreScriptCheckpoint(std::string_view name) {
3157 if (!scriptRuntime_ || !scriptRuntime_->configured)
3158 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict,
3159 "RTS script world must be configured before restoring a checkpoint", "scriptWorld");
3160 const auto found = scriptRuntime_->checkpoints.find(std::string(name));
3161 if (found == scriptRuntime_->checkpoints.end())
3162 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound, "RTS script checkpoint was not found", "name");
3163 const auto& checkpoint = found->second;
3164 const auto expectedCells = static_cast<std::size_t>(scriptRuntime_->width * scriptRuntime_->height);
3165 if (checkpoint.navigationCosts.size() != expectedCells || checkpoint.terrainElevations.size() != expectedCells)
3166 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict, "RTS checkpoint grid dimensions do not match", "grid");
3167 for (const auto& [key, snapshot] : checkpoint.fovs) {
3168 const auto current = scriptRuntime_->fovs.find(key);
3169 if (current == scriptRuntime_->fovs.end() || !current->second ||
3170 snapshot.width != scriptRuntime_->width || snapshot.height != scriptRuntime_->height)
3171 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict, "RTS checkpoint fog topology does not match", "fog");
3172 }
3173 const auto containsPlayer = [this](SubjectRef subject) {
3174 return std::any_of(players_.begin(), players_.end(), [subject](const ecs::EntityHandle& handle) {
3175 auto* player = dynamic_cast<Player*>(ecs::try_get(handle));
3176 return player != nullptr && player->identity()->subject == subject;
3177 });
3178 };
3179 const bool exactTopology = checkpoint.roots.units.size() == unitCount() &&
3180 checkpoint.roots.buildings.size() == buildingCount() &&
3181 checkpoint.roots.resourceNodes.size() == resourceNodeCount() &&
3182 checkpoint.roots.players.size() == playerCount() &&
3183 checkpoint.roots.factions.size() == factionCount() &&
3184 checkpoint.roots.matches.size() == matchCount() &&
3185 std::all_of(checkpoint.roots.units.begin(), checkpoint.roots.units.end(),
3186 [this](const auto& value) { return findUnit(value.subject) != nullptr; }) &&
3187 std::all_of(checkpoint.roots.buildings.begin(), checkpoint.roots.buildings.end(),
3188 [this](const auto& value) { return findBuilding(value.subject) != nullptr; }) &&
3189 std::all_of(checkpoint.roots.resourceNodes.begin(), checkpoint.roots.resourceNodes.end(),
3190 [this](const auto& value) { return findResourceNode(value.subject) != nullptr; }) &&
3191 std::all_of(checkpoint.roots.players.begin(), checkpoint.roots.players.end(),
3192 [&](const auto& value) { return containsPlayer(value.subject); }) &&
3193 std::all_of(checkpoint.roots.factions.begin(), checkpoint.roots.factions.end(),
3194 [this](const auto& value) { return findFaction(value.subject) != nullptr; }) &&
3195 std::all_of(checkpoint.roots.matches.begin(), checkpoint.roots.matches.end(),
3196 [this](const auto& value) { return findMatch(value.subject) != nullptr; });
3197
3198 if (exactTopology) {
3199 auto restored = restoreState(checkpoint.roots);
3200 if (!restored) return restored;
3201 } else {
3202 // Validate the complete graph before touching the live roots. The staged
3203 // module also verifies definition-backed weapon materialization.
3204 {
3205 RTS validator;
3206 validator.setDefinitionRegistry(&scriptRuntime_->definitions);
3207 auto valid = validator.rebuildState(checkpoint.roots);
3208 if (!valid) return valid;
3209 }
3210 auto rollbackRoots = snapshotState();
3211 if (!rollbackRoots) return Result<void>::failure(rollbackRoots.status());
3212 setCrowdProvider(nullptr);
3213 setCombatProviders(nullptr, nullptr);
3214 clearOwnedRoots();
3215 auto rebuilt = rebuildState(checkpoint.roots);
3216 if (!rebuilt) {
3217 const Status failureStatus = rebuilt.status();
3218 clearOwnedRoots();
3219 auto rollback = rebuildState(rollbackRoots.value());
3220 setCrowdProvider(&scriptRuntime_->crowd);
3221 setCombatProviders(&scriptRuntime_->sensing, &scriptRuntime_->damage);
3222 auto rebound = rebindScriptRootProviders();
3223 if (!rollback || !rebound)
3224 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Failed,
3225 "RTS checkpoint restore and live-state rollback both failed", "checkpoint");
3226 return Result<void>::failure(failureStatus);
3227 }
3228 setCrowdProvider(&scriptRuntime_->crowd);
3229 setCombatProviders(&scriptRuntime_->sensing, &scriptRuntime_->damage);
3230 auto rebound = rebindScriptRootProviders();
3231 if (!rebound) return rebound;
3232 }
3233
3234 std::size_t cell = 0;
3235 for (int y = 0; y < scriptRuntime_->height; ++y) {
3236 for (int x = 0; x < scriptRuntime_->width; ++x, ++cell) {
3237 const float cost = checkpoint.navigationCosts[cell];
3238 const bool blocked = cost <= 0.0f;
3239 scriptRuntime_->pathfinder.setBlocked(x, y, blocked);
3240 scriptRuntime_->crowd.setBlocked(x, y, blocked);
3241 if (!blocked) {
3242 scriptRuntime_->pathfinder.setCellCost(x, y, cost);
3243 scriptRuntime_->crowd.setCellCost(x, y, cost);
3244 }
3245 for (auto& [faction, fov] : scriptRuntime_->fovs) {
3246 (void)faction;
3247 if (fov) fov->setOpaque(x, y, blocked);
3248 }
3249 }
3250 }
3251 scriptRuntime_->terrainElevations = checkpoint.terrainElevations;
3252 for (auto& [faction, fov] : scriptRuntime_->fovs) {
3253 (void)faction;
3254 if (!fov) continue;
3255 fov->setMode("heightmap");
3256 fov->setEyeOffset(1.0f);
3257 fov->setCliffBlock(0.0f);
3258 for (int y = 0; y < scriptRuntime_->height; ++y)
3259 for (int x = 0; x < scriptRuntime_->width; ++x)
3260 fov->setElevation(x, y, checkpoint.terrainElevations[
3261 static_cast<std::size_t>(y * scriptRuntime_->width + x)]);
3262 }
3263 std::erase_if(scriptRuntime_->economies, [&](const auto& entry) {
3264 return !checkpoint.economies.contains(entry.first);
3265 });
3266 std::erase_if(scriptRuntime_->fovs, [&](const auto& entry) {
3267 return !checkpoint.fovs.contains(entry.first);
3268 });
3269 for (const auto& [key, snapshot] : checkpoint.economies) {
3270 const auto current = scriptRuntime_->economies.find(key);
3271 if (current == scriptRuntime_->economies.end())
3272 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::Conflict, "RTS checkpoint economy topology does not match", "economy");
3273 current->second->ledger.restore(snapshot);
3274 }
3275 for (const auto& [key, snapshot] : checkpoint.fovs) {
3276 auto restored = scriptRuntime_->fovs.at(key)->restore(snapshot);
3277 if (!restored) return restored;
3278 }
3279 scriptRuntime_->pendingProductionSubjects = checkpoint.pendingProductionSubjects;
3280 scriptRuntime_->paidProduction = checkpoint.paidProduction;
3281 scriptRuntime_->paidConstruction = checkpoint.paidConstruction;
3282 scriptRuntime_->commandLog = checkpoint.commandLog;
3283 scriptRuntime_->nextTick = checkpoint.nextTick;
3284 scriptRuntime_->aiProductionSequence = checkpoint.aiProductionSequence;
3285 const SimulationTick restoredTick{checkpoint.nextTick == 0 ? 0 : checkpoint.nextTick - 1};
3286 for (const auto& handle : units_)
3287 if (auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(handle)))
3288 unit->effects()->values.restoreSchedulerTick(restoredTick);
3289 for (const auto& handle : buildings_)
3290 if (auto* building = dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(handle)))
3291 building->effects()->values.restoreSchedulerTick(restoredTick);
3292 scriptRuntime_->actions.clear();
3293 scriptRuntime_->adapter.clear();
3294 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
3295}

3340
3341void RTS::removeUnitRoot(Unit& unit) {
3342 const auto handle = ecs::handle_of(&unit);
3343 const SubjectRef subject = unit.identity()->subject;
3344 const auto passengers = unit.containment()->occupants;
3345 unit.containment()->occupants.clear();
3346 for (const auto& passengerHandle : passengers) {
3347 auto* passenger = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(passengerHandle));
3348 if (passenger != nullptr && passenger != &unit && owns(units_, *passenger))
3349 removeUnitRoot(*passenger);
3350 }
3351
3352 if (crowd_ != nullptr && unit.crowd()->link.isBound())
3353 crowd_->removeNamedAgent(unit.crowd()->link.key());
3354 const std::string subjectKey = subject.format();
3355 if (sensing_ != nullptr)
3356 sensing_->remove(subjectKey).ignore("best-effort RTS sensing cleanup");
3357 combatState_.mirroredSubjects.erase(subjectKey);
3358 combatState_.blockedSubjects.erase(subjectKey);
3359
3360 for (const auto& nodeHandle : resourceNodes_) {
3361 if (auto* node = dynamic_cast<ResourceNode*>(ecs::try_get(nodeHandle)))
3362 std::erase_if(node->harvest()->workers,
3363 [&](const auto& value) { return sameHandle(value, handle); });
3364 }
3365 for (const auto& buildingHandle : buildings_) {
3366 auto* building = dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(buildingHandle));
3367 if (building == nullptr) continue;
3368 std::erase_if(building->construction()->builders,
3369 [&](const auto& value) { return sameHandle(value, handle); });
3370 std::erase_if(building->garrison()->occupants,
3371 [&](const auto& value) { return sameHandle(value, handle); });
3372 std::erase_if(building->rally()->reinforcements,
3373 [&](const auto& value) { return sameHandle(value, handle); });
3374 if (sameHandle(building->rally()->transport, handle)) {
3375 building->rally()->transport = {};
3376 building->rally()->transportActive = false;
3377 }
3378 building->capture()->blockedByGarrison = !building->garrison()->occupants.empty();
3379 }
3380 for (const auto& otherHandle : units_) {
3381 auto* other = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(otherHandle));
3382 if (other == nullptr || other == &unit) continue;
3383 std::erase_if(other->containment()->occupants,
3384 [&](const auto& value) { return sameHandle(value, handle); });
3385 if (other->containment()->container.isBound() &&
3386 sameHandle(other->containment()->container.handle(), handle))
3387 other->containment()->container = {};
3388 if (sameHandle(other->combat()->target, handle)) other->combat()->target = {};
3389 if (sameHandle(other->tactics()->escortTarget, handle)) other->tactics()->escortTarget = {};
3390 if (sameHandle(other->supply()->assignedTarget, handle)) other->supply()->assignedTarget = {};
3391 if (sameHandle(other->supply()->convoyLeader, handle)) other->supply()->convoyLeader = {};
3392 }
3393 for (const auto& factionHandle : factions_) {
3394 if (auto* faction = dynamic_cast<Faction*>(ecs::try_get(factionHandle)))
3395 std::erase_if(faction->members()->units,
3396 [&](const auto& value) { return sameHandle(value, handle); });
3397 }
3398 for (const auto& playerHandle : players_) {
3399 if (auto* player = dynamic_cast<Player*>(ecs::try_get(playerHandle)))
3400 std::erase_if(player->selection()->units,
3401 [&](const auto& value) { return sameHandle(value, handle); });
3402 }
3403
3404 const auto weaponHandle = unit.weapon()->link.handle();
3405 if (auto* weapon = dynamic_cast<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(unit.weapon()->link.resolve())) weapon->release();
3406 std::erase_if(weapons_, [&](const auto& value) { return sameHandle(value, weaponHandle); });
3407 std::erase_if(units_, [&](const auto& value) { return sameHandle(value, handle); });
3408 if (scriptRuntime_)
3409 std::erase_if(scriptRuntime_->paidProduction,
3410 [&](const auto& value) { return value.resultSubject == subject; });
3411 unit.release();
3412}
3413
3414void RTS::removeBuildingRoot(Building& building, bool destroyOccupants) {
3415 const auto handle = ecs::handle_of(&building);
3416 const SubjectRef subject = building.identity()->subject;
3417 const std::string subjectKey = subject.format();
3418 if (sensing_ != nullptr)
3419 sensing_->remove(subjectKey).ignore("best-effort RTS sensing cleanup");
3420 combatState_.mirroredSubjects.erase(subjectKey);
3421 combatState_.blockedSubjects.erase(subjectKey);
3422 const auto occupants = building.garrison()->occupants;
3423 building.garrison()->occupants.clear();
3424 building.capture()->blockedByGarrison = false;
3425 for (const auto& occupantHandle : occupants) {
3426 auto* occupant = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(occupantHandle));
3427 if (occupant == nullptr || !owns(units_, *occupant)) continue;
3428 occupant->containment()->container = {};
3429 if (destroyOccupants) {
3430 occupant->durability()->alive = false;
3431 occupant->durability()->state.health = 0.0;
3432 removeUnitRoot(*occupant);
3433 } else {
3434 occupant->motion()->x = building.placement()->worldX;
3435 occupant->motion()->y = building.placement()->worldY;
3436 occupant->motion()->arrived = true;
3437 occupant->orders()->values.clear();
3438 }
3439 }
3440 for (const auto& unitHandle : units_) {
3441 auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(unitHandle));
3442 if (unit == nullptr) continue;
3443 if (unit->containment()->container.isBound() &&
3444 sameHandle(unit->containment()->container.handle(), handle))
3445 unit->containment()->container = {};
3446 if (sameHandle(unit->combat()->target, handle)) unit->combat()->target = {};
3447 if (sameHandle(unit->tactics()->escortTarget, handle)) unit->tactics()->escortTarget = {};
3448 if (unit->worker()->dropoff.isBound() && sameHandle(unit->worker()->dropoff.handle(), handle))
3449 unit->worker()->dropoff = {};
3450 }
3451 for (const auto& factionHandle : factions_) {
3452 if (auto* faction = dynamic_cast<Faction*>(ecs::try_get(factionHandle)))
3453 std::erase_if(faction->members()->buildings,
3454 [&](const auto& value) { return sameHandle(value, handle); });
3455 }
3456 for (const auto& playerHandle : players_) {
3457 if (auto* player = dynamic_cast<Player*>(ecs::try_get(playerHandle)))
3458 std::erase_if(player->selection()->buildings,
3459 [&](const auto& value) { return sameHandle(value, handle); });
3460 }
3461 const auto weaponHandle = building.weapon()->link.handle();
3462 if (auto* weapon = dynamic_cast<weapon::WeaponEntity*>(building.weapon()->link.resolve())) weapon->release();
3463 std::erase_if(weapons_, [&](const auto& value) { return sameHandle(value, weaponHandle); });
3464 std::erase_if(buildings_, [&](const auto& value) { return sameHandle(value, handle); });
3465 if (scriptRuntime_) {
3466 std::erase_if(scriptRuntime_->paidConstruction,
3467 [&](const auto& value) { return value.building == subject; });
3468 std::erase_if(scriptRuntime_->paidProduction, [&](const auto& value) {
3469 if (value.producer != subject) return false;
3470 scriptRuntime_->pendingProductionSubjects.erase(value.taskId);
3471 return true;
3472 });
3473 }
3474 building.release();
3475}
3476
3477void RTS::removeResourceNodeRoot(ResourceNode& node) {
3478 const auto handle = ecs::handle_of(&node);
3479 for (const auto& workerHandle : node.harvest()->workers) {
3480 auto* worker = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(workerHandle));
3481 if (worker != nullptr && worker->worker()->resourceNode.isBound() &&
3482 sameHandle(worker->worker()->resourceNode.handle(), handle)) {
3483 worker->worker()->resourceNode = {};
3484 worker->orders()->values.clear();
3485 }
3486 }
3487 node.harvest()->workers.clear();
3488 std::erase_if(resourceNodes_, [&](const auto& value) { return sameHandle(value, handle); });
3489 node.release();
3490}
3491
3492Result<void> RTS::remove(SubjectRef subject) {
3493 if (!subject.isValid())
3494 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument,
3495 "RTS removal requires a valid stable identity", "subject");
3496 if (auto* unit = findUnit(subject)) {
3497 removeUnitRoot(*unit);
3498 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
3499 }
3500 if (auto* building = findBuilding(subject)) {
3501 removeBuildingRoot(*building, false);
3502 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
3503 }
3504 if (auto* node = findResourceNode(subject)) {
3505 removeResourceNodeRoot(*node);
3506 return Result<void>::success(Status::success(StatusCode::Applied));
3507 }
3508 return failure<void>(DiagnosticCode::NotFound,
3509 "RTS gameplay root identity was not found", "subject");
3510}
3511
3512Result<std::size_t> RTS::cleanupDestroyed() {
3513 const std::size_t before = unitCount() + buildingCount();
3514 std::vector<ecs::EntityHandle> deadUnits;
3515 std::vector<ecs::EntityHandle> deadBuildings;
3516 for (const auto& handle : units_) {
3517 auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(handle));
3518 if (unit != nullptr && (!unit->durability()->alive || unit->durability()->state.health <= 0.0))
3519 deadUnits.push_back(handle);
3520 }
3521 for (const auto& handle : buildings_) {
3522 auto* building = dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(handle));
3523 if (building != nullptr && (!building->integrity()->alive || building->integrity()->state.health <= 0.0))
3524 deadBuildings.push_back(handle);
3525 }
3526 for (const auto& handle : deadBuildings) {
3527 auto* building = dynamic_cast<Building*>(ecs::try_get(handle));
3528 if (building == nullptr || !owns(buildings_, *building)) continue;
3529 removeBuildingRoot(*building, true);
3530 }
3531 for (const auto& handle : deadUnits) {
3532 auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(handle));
3533 if (unit == nullptr || !owns(units_, *unit)) continue;
3534 removeUnitRoot(*unit);
3535 }
3536 const std::size_t after = unitCount() + buildingCount();
3537 const std::size_t removed = before >= after ? before - after : 0;
3538 return Result<std::size_t>::success(removed,
3539 Status::success(removed == 0 ? StatusCode::NoOp : StatusCode::Applied));
3540}

3542std::size_t RTS::unitCount() const noexcept { return countLive<Unit>(units_); }
3543std::size_t RTS::buildingCount() const noexcept { return countLive<Building>(buildings_); }
3544std::size_t RTS::resourceNodeCount() const noexcept { return countLive<ResourceNode>(resourceNodes_); }
3545std::size_t RTS::playerCount() const noexcept { return countLive<Player>(players_); }
3546std::size_t RTS::factionCount() const noexcept { return countLive<Faction>(factions_); }
3547std::size_t RTS::matchCount() const noexcept { return countLive<Match>(matches_); }
3548
3549Faction* RTS::findFaction(SubjectRef subject) const noexcept { return findSubject<Faction>(factions_, subject); }
3550Match* RTS::findMatch(SubjectRef subject) const noexcept { return findSubject<Match>(matches_, subject); }
3551
3552Player* RTS::resolvePlayer(SubjectRef subject) const noexcept {
3553 for (const auto& handle : players_) {
3554 auto* player = dynamic_cast<Player*>(ecs::try_get(handle));
3555 if (player && player->identity()->subject == subject) return player;
3556 }
3557 return nullptr;
3558}
3559
3560Unit* RTS::resolveUnit(SubjectRef subject) const noexcept {
3561 for (const auto& handle : units_) {
3562 auto* unit = dynamic_cast<Unit*>(ecs::try_get(handle));
3563 if (unit && unit->identity()->subject == subject) return unit;
3564 }
3565 return nullptr;
3566}

3568void RTS::expose(ssq::Table& table) {

3570 expose(cls);
3571}

4402 const auto queueUnitOrder = [vm](RTS* self, std::int64_t tick,
4403 const std::vector<std::string>& subjectTexts, OrderKind kind,
4404 WorldPosition point, SubjectRef target, bool append,
4405 float formationSpacing) -> ssq::Table {
4406 if (tick < 0)
4407 return script::projectStatusResult(vm, Status::failure(Diagnostic::error(
4408 DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS replay tick must be non-negative", "tick")), false, false);
4409 if (formationSpacing == 0.0f || !std::isfinite(formationSpacing))
4410 return script::projectStatusResult(vm, Status::failure(Diagnostic::error(
4411 DiagnosticCode::InvalidArgument, "RTS replay formation spacing must be positive", "spacing")),
4412 false, false);
4413 auto subjects = parseScriptSubjects(subjectTexts);
4414 if (!subjects) return script::projectStatusResult(vm, subjects.status(), false, false);
4415 RTSReplayCommand replay;
4416 replay.tick = SimulationTick{static_cast<std::uint64_t>(tick)};
4417 replay.units = std::move(subjects).takeValue();
4418 replay.command.kind = kind;
4419 replay.command.target = point;
4420 replay.command.append = append;
4421 replay.targetEntity = target;
4422 if (formationSpacing > 0.0f) {
4423 replay.formation.kind = FormationKind::Grid;
4424 replay.formation.spacing = formationSpacing;
4425 }
4426 return script::projectResult(vm, self->queueScriptCommand(std::move(replay)));
4427 };

4576 cls.addFunc("assignWorker", [vm](RTS* self, const std::string& workerText,

4593 DiagnosticCode::NotFound, "RTS worker assignment root was not found", "assignment")),
4594 false, false);

4700 cls.addFunc("applyStatusEffect", [vm](RTS* self, const std::string& sourceText,
4701 const std::string& targetText, const std::string& effect, float durationOverride) -> ssq::Table {
4702 auto source = parseScriptSubject(sourceText, "source");
4703 if (!source) return script::projectStatusResult(vm, source.status(), false, false);
4704 auto target = parseScriptSubject(targetText, "target");
4705 if (!target) return script::projectStatusResult(vm, target.status(), false, false);
4706 return script::projectResult(vm,
4707 self->applyStatusEffect(source.value(), target.value(), effect,
4708 static_cast<double>(durationOverride)),
